title: Formalism as Uncertainty Absorption: A Reconsideration

detail.title: Formalism as Uncertainty Absorption: A Reconsideration
detail.abstract: Existing frameworks explain organizational formalism as symbolic compliance with institutional demands (decoupling), pathological bureaucratic expansion (rationalization), or disciplinary control (control-resistance). Yet these frameworks predict formalism should be minimized where possible, reach self-limiting thresholds, or be resisted-none of which fully accounts for the persistent elaboration of formalistic labor observed in contemporary organizations. This paper reconsiders this pattern by specifying an additional logic operating alongside legitimation, coordination, and control: uncertainty absorption. When actors cannot predict how their decisions will be retrospectively evaluated, procedural correctness offers outcome-invariant legitimacy-a defense that remains valid regardless of results. Documentation shifts from recording completed actions to preempting future reinterpretation, functioning as an epistemic infrastructure that stabilizes what can later be recognized as valid knowledge of action under evaluative volatility. This generates rational over-documentation beyond external requirements. The mechanism helps clarify why formalistic labor expands voluntarily, persists without equilibrium, and intensifies even as actors complain about burdens. The argument applies under specific scope conditions and does not explain why evaluative unpredictability emerges, why formalism dominates over alternative adaptations, or whether the pattern is stable or transitional.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"不确定性吸收"作为解释组织形式主义持续扩张的新逻辑，认为当行动者无法预测决策如何被事后评估时，程序正确性提供了结果不变的合法性，导致自愿性过度文档化。
AI.research_question: 为什么当代组织中形式主义劳动会持续扩张，即使行动者抱怨其负担？
AI.motivation: 现有框架（制度脱耦、官僚理性化、控制-抵抗）无法充分解释形式主义劳动的持续精细化扩张，这些框架预测形式主义应被最小化、达到自我限制阈值或被抵制，但现实却相反。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性吸收理论，作为合法化、协调和控制之外的补充逻辑，强调程序正确性在评估不确定性下的合法性功能。
AI.method: 理论构建和概念分析，通过提出新机制解释现有理论无法解释的现象。
AI.findings: 当行动者无法预测决策如何被事后评估时，程序正确性提供了结果不变的合法性；文档化从记录已完成行动转变为预防未来重新解释；这导致超出外部要求的理性过度文档化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"不确定性吸收"作为解释组织形式主义扩张的新理论机制；将形式主义重新概念化为应对评估不确定性的认知基础设施；解释了形式主义劳动的自愿扩张、无均衡持续和抱怨中的强化现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助管理者理解形式主义扩张的内在逻辑；为组织设计更有效的评估和问责系统提供理论基础；揭示形式主义负担背后的理性动机。

title: Music Recommender Systems And the Copyright Blind Spot: Conceptualising the Right to Be Heard
affiliations: University of Amsterdam - Institute for Information Law (IViR)

detail.title: Music Recommender Systems And the Copyright Blind Spot: Conceptualising the Right to Be Heard
detail.abstract:
Digital music platforms project an image of unprecedented abundance, linguistic diversity, and borderless circulation, yet the infrastructures that organise musical discovery increasingly shape who is heard and who remains silent. 
This paper argues that while EU copyright law effectively secures lawful availability, rights management, and remuneration, it remains structurally indifferent to the allocation of cultural attention. As musical discovery is now mediated primarily through algorithmic recommender systems, visibility has ceased to be a by-product of access and has become a function of metadata, optimisation, and design. The resulting condition of being represented but not heard exposes a doctrinal blind spot in the European copyright acquis and raises broader constitutional concerns relating to artistic freedom, freedom of expression, and cultural participation. 
Against this backdrop the paper conceptualises a right to be heard as a relational and infrastructural dimension of cultural participation and explores whether prominence-based regulatory approach, inspired by the AVMS Directive, could offer a proportionate response to algorithmically mediated cultural exclusion in the internal market that is compatible with the freedom to conduct a business.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字音乐平台如何通过算法推荐系统塑造文化注意力分配，指出欧盟版权法虽保障作品合法可用性和报酬，但对文化可见性分配存在结构性盲点，提出"被听见权"概念并探讨基于显著性的监管方案。
AI.research_question: 欧盟版权法如何应对算法推荐系统导致的"被代表但未被听见"现象，以及基于显著性的监管方法能否在内部市场中解决算法中介的文化排斥问题？
AI.motivation: 数字音乐平台表面上提供前所未有的丰富性、语言多样性和无国界流通，但其基础设施（特别是算法推荐系统）实际上塑造了谁被听见、谁保持沉默的文化注意力分配，而现行欧盟版权法对此存在结构性盲点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 版权法理论（特别是欧盟版权法体系）；2) 算法中介理论（算法推荐系统如何调解文化发现）；3) 文化参与理论；4) 基础设施研究；5) 宪法权利理论（艺术自由、表达自由、文化参与权）
AI.method: 法律分析和理论建构方法，包括：1) 对欧盟版权法体系（acquis）的教义学分析；2) 对算法推荐系统运作机制的理论分析；3) 概念建构（"被听见权"作为文化参与的关系性和基础设施维度）；4) 比较法分析（借鉴AVMS指令的基于显著性的监管方法）
AI.findings: 1) 欧盟版权法有效保障了作品的合法可用性、权利管理和报酬，但对文化注意力的分配保持结构性漠视；2) 在算法推荐系统主导音乐发现的背景下，可见性已从访问的副产品转变为元数据、优化和设计的函数；3) "被代表但未被听见"的状况暴露了欧盟版权法的教义盲点，并引发艺术自由、表达自由和文化参与的宪法关切；4) "被听见权"应被概念化为文化参与的关系性和基础设施维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"被听见权"作为版权法和文化政策的新概念框架；2) 揭示算法中介对文化可见性的结构性影响；3) 将基础设施视角引入版权法分析；4) 拓展文化参与理论的关系性和物质性维度；5) 为算法治理提供基于显著性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供应对算法中介文化排斥的监管思路；2) 提出借鉴AVMS指令的基于显著性的监管方案；3) 为平衡文化多样性与商业自由提供具体路径；4) 为数字平台的内容发现系统设计提供规范性指导；5) 为艺术家和文化工作者的权利主张提供理论依据。

title: How Pang Donglai Maintains Reputation Resilience: LDA Topic Modeling and Cross-Platform Sentiment Analysis
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: How Pang Donglai Maintains Reputation Resilience: LDA Topic Modeling and Cross-Platform Sentiment Analysis
detail.abstract: The retail brand “Pangdonglai” renowned for its exceptional product quality and service, has cultivated a strong word-of-mouth reputation that spreads widely across social media, further driving offline store traffic. This research aims not only to explore the public’ s multi-dimensional perceptions of the Pangdonglai brand but also to delve into the underlying sentiments associated with these perceptions. Employing LDA thematic modelling and sentiment analysis, text data related to “Pandonglai” was collected from five major social media platforms: Weibo, WeChat, Rednote, Zhihu, and Toutiao. This enabled thematic identification, sentiment polarity assessment, and cross-platform comparative analysis, constructing a three-dimensional correlation map linking themes, platforms, and sentiment. Findings indicate that Pandonglai’ s public sentiment themes primarily encompass five categories: retail membership and culinary shopping experiences; consumer rights and market supervision; labour employment and corporate culture; Significant variations exist across platforms in thematic distribution and sentiment orientation, with Weibo exhibiting predominantly negative oversight and WeChat displaying positive cultural dissemination. Recommendations include establishing a precision-targeted public sentiment response mechanism categorised by platform, theme, and sentiment, alongside strengthening corporate cultural communication and service consistency to enhance brand reputation and public sentiment governance efficacy.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过LDA主题建模和情感分析，分析胖东来品牌在五大社交媒体平台的公众认知与情感，发现主题分布和情感倾向存在平台差异，建议建立精准舆情应对机制。
AI.research_question: 胖东来品牌在社交媒体上的公众多维认知是什么？这些认知背后的情感倾向如何？不同社交媒体平台在主题分布和情感导向上有何差异？
AI.motivation: 胖东来以其卓越的产品质量和服务建立了强大的口碑，社交媒体上的广泛传播进一步推动了线下客流。需要深入了解公众对品牌的多维认知和情感，以优化品牌声誉管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体舆情分析理论、品牌声誉管理理论、情感分析理论、LDA主题建模方法、跨平台比较分析框架
AI.method: 采用LDA主题建模和情感分析方法，从微博、微信、小红书、知乎、头条五大社交媒体平台收集"胖东来"相关文本数据，进行主题识别、情感极性评估和跨平台比较分析，构建主题-平台-情感三维关联图。
AI.findings: 1. 胖东来公众情感主题主要涵盖五类：零售会员与美食购物体验、消费者权益与市场监管、劳动就业与企业文化等；2. 不同平台在主题分布和情感导向上存在显著差异：微博以负面监督为主，微信呈现积极文化传播；3. 构建了主题-平台-情感三维关联图。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了社交媒体品牌舆情分析的三维框架（主题-平台-情感）；2. 揭示了不同社交媒体平台在品牌舆情传播中的差异化角色；3. 丰富了品牌声誉管理的跨平台比较分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议建立按平台、主题、情感分类的精准靶向舆情应对机制；2. 提出加强企业文化传播和服务一致性建设；3. 为提升品牌声誉和舆情治理效能提供具体策略。

title: From Elephants to Schrödinger's Cat: "Cybernetic Blindness" Across Systems How Fragments Disguised as Wholes Distort Algorithms, Policies, and the Fabric of Reality
affiliations: The Permaculture Association (Britain)

detail.title: From Elephants to Schrödinger's Cat: "Cybernetic Blindness" Across Systems How Fragments Disguised as Wholes Distort Algorithms, Policies, and the Fabric of Reality
detail.abstract: Cybernetic blindness-the systemic error of mistaking fragments for wholes-recurs across disciplines, from algorithms to ecology to quantum physics. Drawing on information theory, cybernetics, and systems thinking, this article shows how blindness arises whenever the observer's role is ignored and partial signals are treated as complete. Engineering reduces information to uncertainty; biology treats it as instruction; physics embeds it in matter and energy-yet these definitions migrate across fields without translation, generating conceptual distortions. Revisiting Schrödinger's cat, relativity, and Hamilton's rule, the paper reframes paradoxes and anomalies as failures to recognize embedded observers, ecological cycles, and systemic circularity. Altruism, often modelled as a genetic trade-off, is shown to be ecological and relational, with costs recycled into resilience. Modern systems-machine learning, policy dashboards, economic models-amplify these blind spots by scaling fragments into decision-making architectures. By situating these examples within the broader fragmentation of science, the article argues that circularity and complexity are not exceptions but the foundational architecture of reality. Overcoming cybernetic blindness requires cultivating awareness of wholeness, limitation, and the informational fabric of systems, and developing a cross-disciplinary "Rosetta Stone" to translate concepts across scientific domains.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了"控制论盲点"现象——将部分误认为整体的系统性错误，该现象在算法、生态学、量子物理等多个学科中反复出现。文章基于信息论、控制论和系统思维，展示了当忽略观察者角色并将部分信号视为完整时，盲点如何产生。通过重新审视薛定谔的猫、相对论和汉密尔顿法则等案例，文章将悖论和异常重新定义为未能识别嵌入的观察者、生态循环和系统循环性的失败。文章认为，循环性和复杂性不是例外，而是现实的基本架构，克服控制论盲点需要培养对整体性、局限性和系统信息结构的认识。
AI.research_question: 控制论盲点（将部分误认为整体的系统性错误）如何在不同学科中反复出现？如何通过信息论、控制论和系统思维来理解和克服这种盲点？
AI.motivation: 控制论盲点——将碎片误认为整体的系统性错误——在从算法到生态学到量子物理的多个学科中反复出现。这种盲点导致概念扭曲、悖论和异常，特别是在现代系统（机器学习、政策仪表板、经济模型）中，这些系统将碎片放大到决策架构中。科学领域的碎片化加剧了这一问题，不同学科对信息的定义（工程学视为不确定性，生物学视为指令，物理学视为物质和能量）在没有适当翻译的情况下跨领域迁移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息理论、控制论、系统思维、观察者理论、生态循环理论、系统循环性理论
AI.method: 跨学科概念分析、案例研究（薛定谔的猫、相对论、汉密尔顿法则）、理论重构、系统分析
AI.findings:
1. 控制论盲点在不同学科中普遍存在，源于忽略观察者角色并将部分信号视为完整
2. 利他主义通常被建模为基因权衡，但实际上是生态性和关系性的，成本被循环利用为韧性
3. 现代系统（机器学习、政策仪表板、经济模型）通过将碎片放大到决策架构中加剧了这些盲点
4. 悖论和异常是未能识别嵌入的观察者、生态循环和系统循环性的失败
5. 循环性和复杂性不是例外，而是现实的基本架构
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"控制论盲点"的概念框架，解释了跨学科的系统性错误
2. 重新定义了悖论和异常作为观察者嵌入和系统循环性失败的产物
3. 发展了信息在不同学科中定义迁移的理论分析
4. 提出了循环性和复杂性作为现实基本架构的系统观
5. 为跨学科概念翻译提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为识别和克服跨学科研究中的控制论盲点提供了方法论指导
2. 为系统设计者（机器学习工程师、政策制定者、经济学家）提供了避免碎片化决策的框架
3. 提出了开发跨学科"罗塞塔石碑"以促进概念翻译的实际建议
4. 为培养对整体性、局限性和系统信息结构的认识提供了实践路径
5. 为生态管理和系统韧性建设提供了新的视角

title: Interpretable decision model for online travel purchase forecasting: Insights from user segmentation

detail.title: Interpretable decision model for online travel purchase forecasting: Insights from user segmentation
detail.abstract: Achieving a comprehensive understanding of online users’ purchasing behavior can significantlyenhance the performance of e-commerce businesses. Existing online purchase forecasting methodshave three main shortcomings: limited focus on tourism-specific purchasing behaviors, a one-size-fits-allpredictionwithoutafine-grainedusersegmentation, andpoorinterpretabilityofresultsfacedby the machine learning and deep learning models. This paper addresses these issues by enhancingthe understanding of online purchase behavior in tourism e-commerce. Specifically, we perform afine-grained user segmentation based on browsing histories and design relevant variables for fore-casting online travel purchases. Following this, we propose a session-based prediction framework,utilizing eleven machine learning and deep learning methods as base classifiers. Additionally, weoffer multiple explanatory forms for the purchase forecasting result by introducing a SHAP-PDPhybrid interpretation module. Experiments with three real-life travel datasets demonstrate thatXGBoost outperforms the other ten methods. This study contributes to the literature on purchaseforecasting and provides practical insights for tourism e-commerce platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于会话的旅游电商购买预测框架，通过细粒度用户分群和SHAP-PDP混合解释模块，提升在线旅游购买行为的预测准确性和可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过细粒度用户分群和可解释的机器学习方法，更准确地预测在线旅游电商平台的用户购买行为？
AI.motivation: 现有在线购买预测方法存在三个主要不足：1) 缺乏针对旅游特定购买行为的关注；2) 采用"一刀切"预测而缺乏细粒度用户分群；3) 机器学习和深度学习模型结果可解释性差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于用户浏览历史的细粒度用户分群理论、会话行为分析理论、可解释人工智能理论（SHAP和PDP方法）。
AI.method: 1) 基于浏览历史进行细粒度用户分群；2) 设计相关预测变量；3) 提出基于会话的预测框架，使用11种机器学习和深度学习方法作为基础分类器；4) 引入SHAP-PDP混合解释模块提供多种解释形式。
AI.findings: 在三个真实旅游数据集上的实验表明，XGBoost方法在11种方法中表现最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了购买预测文献，特别是针对旅游电商领域；2) 提出了结合细粒度用户分群和可解释AI的预测框架；3) 验证了会话行为分析在旅游购买预测中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为旅游电商平台提供实用的购买预测工具；2) 通过可解释结果帮助平台理解用户行为模式；3) 基于用户分群的预测可支持个性化营销策略。

affiliations: Guangdong University of Technology, Guangdong University of Technology, Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Based on the S-O-R Model:The Impact of Doujin Community Norms on Users’ Continuance Intention
detail.abstract: With the rapid development of user-generated content (UGC) platforms in the current Internet environment. A growing number of anime or game works have gained more development opportunities through the secondary dissemination of doujin works. Against this backdrop, as the primary dissemination carrier of doujin works, the interaction mode between doujin community platforms and consumers has become a subject worthy of in-depth research. Therefore, this study aims to construct an empirical model to explore the impact of content quality, participatory culture and interaction ritual in doujin communities on users’ expectation-confirmation and continuance intention, with the structural equation modeling (SEM) method adopted for hypothesis testing. The theoretical framework of this study is built on the Stimulus-Organism-Response (SOR) model, where content quality, participatory culture and interaction ritual are identified as the stimulus variables; expectation-confirmation as the organism variable; and continuance intention as the response variable. The results indicate that both the quality of works published in doujin communities and the interaction patterns among community members exert a significant positive impact on users’ experience. Specifically, these factors positively affect users’ expectation-confirmation during the usage process, which in turn enhances their continuance intention toward the doujin community. In conclusion, doujin platforms should encourage creators to produce and publish high-quality works within the community, provide more functional channels for users to participate in community governance, and foster unique interaction rituals for each sub-community. These variables play a crucial role in satisfying users’ demands, attracting doujin enthusiasts, and building the popularity and influence of doujin platforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于SOR模型，探讨同人社区中内容质量、参与文化和互动仪式对用户期望确认和持续使用意愿的影响。研究发现内容质量和互动模式显著正向影响用户体验和持续使用意愿。
AI.research_question: 同人社区平台的内容质量、参与文化和互动仪式如何影响用户的期望确认和持续使用意愿？
AI.motivation: 随着UGC平台的快速发展，动漫游戏作品通过同人作品的二次传播获得更多发展机会。作为同人作品的主要传播载体，同人社区平台与消费者的互动模式值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于刺激-机体-反应（SOR）模型：内容质量、参与文化和互动仪式作为刺激变量；期望确认作为机体变量；持续使用意愿作为反应变量。
AI.method: 采用结构方程模型（SEM）进行假设检验，构建实证模型。
AI.findings: 同人社区发布的作品质量和社区成员间的互动模式对用户体验有显著正向影响。这些因素正向影响用户使用过程中的期望确认，进而增强他们对同人社区的持续使用意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 将SOR模型应用于同人社区研究，识别了内容质量、参与文化和互动仪式作为关键刺激变量，扩展了期望确认理论在UGC平台的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 同人平台应鼓励创作者发布高质量作品，提供用户参与社区治理的功能渠道，培育各子社区的独特互动仪式，以满足用户需求、吸引爱好者并提升平台影响力。

detail.abstract: Pandemics, natural disasters, and economic crises are the disasters that change consumer behaviour greatly because they cause intense psychological reactions, which influence the abnormal buying behaviour. Fear, anxiety, and greater uncertainty raise perceived risk and drive consumers into panic buying, stockpiling and risk-averse behaviour toward essential rather than non-essential consumption by making decisions. The necessity to restore a sense of control also encourages consumers to hoard and brand switch in case of unavailability of desired products, which supports the decision-making that is short-term and security-based. These effects are enhanced by social influence and media exposure, which disseminates images and stories of scarcity and enhances herd behaviour and heightens demand spikes in markets. The business organisations, in turn, implement various marketing interventions such as compassionate crisis communications, ethical and consistent pricing, demarketing in order to deter hoarding, and dynamic supply chain and inventory management to stabilise the supply of products. Companies restructure product, price, location, and promotion policies whereby they focus on the psychological requirements of the consumers, in terms of safety, reliability, and transparency, in taking advantage of the digital channels and social media in providing real-time news.

AI.tldr: 灾难事件（如疫情、自然灾害、经济危机）通过引发恐惧、焦虑和不确定性，显著改变消费者行为，导致恐慌性购买、囤积和风险规避行为。企业通过危机沟通、道德定价、供应链管理等营销干预措施应对，并调整营销策略以满足消费者的心理需求。
AI.research_question: 灾难事件如何影响消费者行为，以及企业应采取哪些营销策略来应对这些行为变化？
AI.motivation: 灾难事件（如疫情、自然灾害、经济危机）对消费者心理和行为产生深远影响，导致异常购买行为，这对企业营销策略制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理学理论（恐惧、焦虑、不确定性）、风险感知理论、控制感理论、社会影响理论（从众行为）和媒体效应理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和理论分析，未明确说明具体研究方法，但可能是概念性论文或理论构建。
AI.findings: 灾难引发恐惧、焦虑和不确定性，导致消费者风险感知增加，进而产生恐慌性购买、囤积、风险规避行为（偏向必需品）、品牌转换等行为。社会影响和媒体曝光加剧了这些行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合心理学、风险感知和社会影响理论，构建了灾难情境下消费者行为变化的综合理论框架，解释了异常购买行为的内在机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了具体的营销干预措施：危机沟通、道德定价、反囤货营销、动态供应链管理，以及调整产品、价格、渠道、促销策略以满足消费者心理需求。

title: Will AI Trigger Layoffs and Kill the Gig? The Role of Generalist AI under Hybrid Staffing
affiliations: Boston College - Carroll School of Management, Boston College, Carroll School of Management and Boston College

detail.title: Will AI Trigger Layoffs and Kill the Gig? The Role of Generalist AI under Hybrid Staffing
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology reshaping how work is performed across industries. In this paper, we study how AI can alter optimal staffing and work composition for firms that rely on both full-time employees and flexible contractors. We develop a theoretical model of a multi-service company facing uncertain demand, where workers can be hired as permanent employees (reliable but rigid) or as pay-as-needed contractors (flexible but not always available). Crucially, the firm might change the staffing decisions depending on how the AI system augments workers’ productivity. We distinguish specialist AI (which improves performance on a worker’s primary service only) from generalist AI (which uniformly boosts performance across all services). Our analysis produces two key insights. First, we show that the composition of the workforce responds to AI in a nontrivial way: specialist AI tends to reinforce reliance on flexible contractors, whereas generalist AI increases the value of permanent employees and can slow or even reverse the expansion of gig work. This result highlights that projections about the future growth of gig work critically depend on how AI reshapes the workplace, and that gig work may become less attractive if AI substantially improves workers’ cross-functional skills. Second, a more generalist AI (one that enables workers to cross-skill across services and enhances their cross-functional capabilities) can actually increase total employment by allowing each worker to fulfill multiple services, whereas a highly specialized AI reduces overall staffing. This is particularly intriguing given that many firms expect to shrink their labor force in response to AI, while our results show that under some conditions, they should optimally plan to hire more workers. Taken together, these findings suggest that the shape of AI matters: broad, cross-functional AI may mitigate some risks of automation by complementing human flexibility and enabling cross-skilling, whereas narrow, service-specific AI is more likely to substitute for workers in particular services and trigger layoffs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式AI如何影响企业最优人员配置和工作构成。研究发现：专业型AI倾向于强化对灵活承包商（零工）的依赖，而通用型AI则增加全职员工的价值并可能减缓零工扩张；通用型AI还能通过提升跨服务能力增加总就业，而专业型AI则会减少总人员配置。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何改变依赖全职员工和灵活承包商的多服务企业的最优人员配置和工作构成？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在重塑各行业的工作方式，但AI如何影响企业的人员配置决策（特别是全职员工与灵活承包商的比例）尚不清楚。企业面临AI可能替代或增强劳动力的不确定性，需要理解不同类型的AI（专业型vs通用型）对人员配置策略的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建多服务企业面临不确定需求的理论模型，比较两种雇佣模式：可靠但刚性的永久员工 vs 灵活但不总是可用的按需承包商。区分两种AI类型：仅提升员工主要服务绩效的专业型AI vs 均匀提升所有服务绩效的通用型AI。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，分析企业在不同AI类型（专业型vs通用型）影响下的最优人员配置决策，考察AI如何改变全职员工与灵活承包商的比例以及总就业水平。
AI.findings: 1. 专业型AI倾向于强化对灵活承包商（零工）的依赖，而通用型AI增加永久员工的价值并可能减缓甚至逆转零工扩张；2. 通用型AI通过使员工能够履行多项服务来增加总就业，而专业型AI减少总人员配置；3. AI的形态很重要：广泛、跨功能的AI可能通过补充人类灵活性和实现跨技能来减轻自动化风险，而狭窄、服务特定的AI更可能替代特定服务的工人并引发裁员。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析AI类型（专业型vs通用型）对企业人员配置决策的理论影响；2. 揭示AI对零工经济扩张的复杂影响机制；3. 提出AI通过改变员工跨服务能力影响总就业的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助企业根据采用的AI类型制定不同的人员配置策略；2. 挑战"AI必然导致裁员"的普遍预期，指出通用型AI可能增加就业；3. 为政策制定者提供指导：支持发展通用型AI可能有助于缓解自动化带来的就业冲击。

title: Consumer Behavior Within a Disaster and Marketing Strategies Adopted by Business Organizations

detail.title: Consumer Behavior Within a Disaster and Marketing Strategies Adopted by Business Organizations
detail.abstract: Disasters such as pandemics, natural hazards, and sudden crises can disrupt normal consumer behaviors and market dynamics. During these situations, consumers often experience fear, uncertainty, risk perceptions which leads to panic buying behavior and stockpiling. This review paper examines how consumer behavior changes during disaster context with focusing on panic buying, stockpiling and shifting priorities. It also examines how business respond through adopted marketing strategies. Existing literatures reveal that these behaviors are mainly driven by psychological factors such as anxiety, fear, risk perception. Furthermore, they explain social media and the behavior of others increase these reactions by spreading fear and urgency. This paper also discusses how businesses adopt marketing strategies related to supply chain management, pricing, communication and ethical practices to reduce panic and build customer trust. Theoretical perspectives such as Theory of Planned Behavior, Protection Motivation Theory and SOR Model provide a foundation for understanding these situations. By reviewing key theories and existing literatures, this study identifies key research gaps, especially the lack of integrated perspectives from developing countries in disaster-related consumer research.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文探讨了灾难情境下消费者行为的变化（特别是恐慌性购买和囤积行为），以及企业如何通过营销策略应对。研究发现这些行为主要由心理因素驱动，社交媒体会加剧反应，而企业可以通过供应链管理、定价、沟通和道德实践来减少恐慌。
AI.research_question: 灾难情境下消费者行为如何变化（特别是恐慌性购买和囤积行为），以及企业如何通过营销策略应对这些变化？
AI.motivation: 灾难（如疫情、自然灾害、突发危机）会扰乱正常的消费者行为和市场动态，导致恐慌性购买和囤积行为，需要理解这些现象并为企业提供应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论、保护动机理论、SOR模型（刺激-机体-反应模型）
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统回顾现有研究文献
AI.findings: 1. 灾难情境下的消费者行为主要由焦虑、恐惧、风险感知等心理因素驱动；2. 社交媒体和他人的行为会通过传播恐惧和紧迫感加剧这些反应；3. 企业可以通过供应链管理、定价策略、沟通方式和道德实践来减少恐慌并建立客户信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合了计划行为理论、保护动机理论和SOR模型来解释灾难情境下的消费者行为；2. 识别了现有研究的理论空白，特别是缺乏发展中国家的综合视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供了应对灾难情境的营销策略框架；2. 强调了供应链管理、定价、沟通和道德实践在减少恐慌和建立信任中的重要性；3. 指出了未来研究应关注发展中国家在灾难相关消费者研究中的视角。

title: Consumer Behavior Within a Disaster and Marketing Strategies Adopted by Business Organizations During the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Literature Review
affiliations: Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka

detail.title: Consumer Behavior Within a Disaster and Marketing Strategies Adopted by Business Organizations During the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Literature Review
detail.abstract: In addition to changing consumer decision-making, the COVID-19 pandemic caused a significant worldwide disruption that limited corporate operations. Consumers in several areas responded to perceived scarcity, health-related anxiety, and economic instability with unique behaviors like stockpiling, brand switching, panic buying, and a faster uptake of online and contactless shopping. Businesses responded by redesigning their marketing plans to maintain demand, safeguard supply, and comfort consumers during lockdowns and mobility limitations. In addition to analyzing the marketing tactics utilized by businesses during the crisis, this article offers a thorough overview of the literature on consumer behavior in disaster situations with a concentrated synthesis of data from the COVID-19 pandemic. Based on peer-reviewed research in consumer behavior, retailing, digital marketing, and operations, the review groups findings into three categories: (i) observable behavioral outcomes (panic buying, stockpiling, online migration); (ii) key behavioral drivers (fear, uncertainty, need for closure, and social influence); and (iii) organizational responses (assortment and rationing decisions, transparent communications, digital and omnichannel acceleration, and trust- and ethics-led messaging). According to the synthesis, credible communication to lower uncertainty, customer-centric channel integration that maintains ease and safety, and coordinated demand management and supply resilience are all necessary for effective disaster-time marketing. The study identifies research gaps pertinent to future disasters and finishes with managerial implications for developing crisis-ready marketing skills.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了COVID-19疫情期间消费者行为变化和企业营销应对策略，将研究发现归纳为三类：可观察的行为结果（恐慌购买、囤积、线上迁移）、关键行为驱动因素（恐惧、不确定性、闭合需求、社会影响）以及组织响应策略（产品组合与配给决策、透明沟通、数字与全渠道加速、信任与道德导向的信息传递）。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情期间消费者行为发生了哪些变化？企业如何调整营销策略来应对这些变化？有效的灾难时期营销需要哪些关键要素？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行不仅改变了消费者决策，还造成了全球性商业运营中断。消费者因感知稀缺、健康焦虑和经济不稳定而表现出独特行为（如囤积、品牌转换、恐慌购买、加速线上购物），企业需要重新设计营销计划来维持需求、保障供应并在封锁期间安抚消费者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为、零售、数字营销和运营管理领域的理论，构建了灾难时期消费者行为的三维框架：行为结果、行为驱动因素和组织响应策略。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理了同行评审的消费者行为、零售、数字营销和运营管理研究，对COVID-19疫情期间的数据进行集中综合分析。
AI.findings: 1. 可观察行为结果：恐慌购买、囤积、向线上迁移；2. 关键行为驱动因素：恐惧、不确定性、闭合需求、社会影响；3. 组织响应策略：产品组合与配给决策、透明沟通、数字与全渠道加速、信任与道德导向的信息传递。有效的灾难营销需要降低不确定性的可信沟通、保持便利与安全的以客户为中心的渠道整合、协调的需求管理与供应韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了灾难时期消费者行为的综合理论框架，整合了行为结果、驱动因素和组织响应的三维视角，为未来灾难情境下的消费者行为研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了危机准备营销能力的实践指导：通过可信沟通降低不确定性、实施以客户为中心的全渠道整合、协调需求管理与供应韧性，并识别了未来灾难相关的研究空白。

title: Generative AI and Entrepreneurship
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Finance Area, UNC Kenan-Flagler Business School - Finance Area, University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Kenan-Flagler Business School and University of Pennsylvania, School of Arts & Sciences, Department of Economics, Students

detail.title: Generative AI and Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract: This paper studies how Generative AI (Gen AI) is reshaping the U.S. startup ecosystem. Exploiting the release of ChatGPT in November 2022, we show that startups with greater pre-release Gen AI task exposure reduced employment within two quarters, primarily among junior and implementation roles. Displaced workers experienced longer unemployment spells and moved to lower-paying but less exposed jobs. Conversely, exposed startups increased productivity, scaled faster, and accelerated through financing rounds. Venture capital shifted toward frequent, smaller investments, boosting new firm formation. Overall, Gen AI catalyzed a reallocation of resources, shrinking incumbent startup employment while raising new firm entry, leaving aggregate startup employment unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用ChatGPT发布作为准自然实验，发现Gen AI导致暴露度高的初创企业减少就业（特别是初级和实施岗位），但提高了生产率和融资速度，同时风险投资转向更频繁的小额投资，促进了新企业形成，总体上初创企业总就业保持不变但资源重新分配。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何重塑美国初创企业生态系统？具体而言，Gen AI如何影响初创企业的就业、生产率、融资模式和新企业形成？
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能的快速发展对劳动力市场和企业运营产生深远影响，但缺乏关于其对初创企业生态系统系统性影响的实证证据。理解Gen AI如何重塑创业动态对政策制定者和企业家至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术替代理论、资源重新分配理论和创业动态理论，研究Gen AI如何通过任务自动化、生产率提升和融资模式变化影响初创企业生态系统。
AI.method: 利用ChatGPT于2022年11月发布作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）比较Gen AI任务暴露度不同的初创企业在发布前后的变化，分析就业、生产率、融资等指标。
AI.findings: 1. Gen AI暴露度高的初创企业减少就业（特别是初级和实施岗位）；2. 被替代工人经历更长的失业期并转向薪酬较低但暴露度低的工作；3. 暴露企业生产率提高、扩张更快、融资加速；4. 风险投资转向更频繁的小额投资；5. 新企业形成增加；6. 初创企业总就业保持不变但资源重新分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为技术替代理论提供新证据，显示Gen AI对特定岗位的差异化影响；2. 扩展资源重新分配理论，揭示Gen AI如何同时促进企业内和企业间资源流动；3. 丰富创业动态理论，阐明技术冲击如何改变融资模式和新企业形成。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为初创企业提供Gen AI采用策略参考；2. 为风险投资者提供投资模式调整依据；3. 为政策制定者提供劳动力市场转型的政策建议；4. 为教育机构提供技能培训方向指导。

title: Interpretation Nudges and Self-Control

detail.title: Interpretation Nudges and Self-Control
detail.abstract: This paper studies interpretation nudges: interventions that cannot change an objectively generated signal but offer alternative statistical models for interpreting its realizations. Present-biased decision makers select from a menu the model that maximizes statistical fit to the signal realization at their prior, update beliefs, and then decide whether to abstain from a vicious good. I study menu design under asymmetric paternalistic no-harm constraints. In a three-model menu with a binary signal space, I characterize prior-relative no-harm and show that baseline-relative no-harm reduces to a finite check over priors. I then develop an operational search procedure for welfare-improving interpretation nudges within a family of conflicting models. A numerical example illustrates when extreme narratives crowd out welfare-improving abstention and how the conflicting-models search yields pointwise no-harm improvements.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"解释助推"：这些干预措施不能改变客观生成的信号，但提供了替代的统计模型来解释信号的实现。存在现时偏好的决策者从菜单中选择能最大化信号实现与先验统计拟合度的模型，更新信念，然后决定是否放弃"恶习商品"。论文在不对称父爱主义无伤害约束下研究菜单设计。
AI.research_question: 在不对称父爱主义无伤害约束下，如何设计解释助推菜单来改善存在现时偏好的决策者的福利？
AI.motivation: 决策者常常存在现时偏好，会选择能证实自己偏好的解释模型，导致做出有害决策。解释助推通过提供替代解释模型来影响决策，但需要确保不伤害任何决策者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现时偏好理论、贝叶斯更新、不对称父爱主义、解释助推理论、菜单设计理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法：在二元信号空间的三模型菜单中，刻画先验相对无伤害条件；开发冲突模型族中福利改进解释助推的操作性搜索程序；使用数值示例说明
AI.findings: 1. 在二元信号空间的三模型菜单中，可以刻画先验相对无伤害条件；2. 基准相对无伤害简化为对先验的有限检查；3. 极端叙事可能挤出福利改进的放弃行为；4. 冲突模型搜索能产生点态无伤害改进
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化了解释助推的概念框架；2. 建立了不对称父爱主义约束下的菜单设计理论；3. 开发了冲突模型族中福利改进解释助推的搜索算法；4. 提供了无伤害条件的可操作特征化
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计解释助推提供了理论指导；2. 提供了确保无伤害的实用检查方法；3. 展示了如何避免极端叙事挤出福利改进决策；4. 为行为干预设计提供了可操作的工具

title: Consumer Resilience in the Face of Cascading Disasters: A Comparative Analysis of Marketing Adaptations from COVID-19 to Cyclone Ditwah in Sri Lanka.
affiliations: , Unaffiliated Authors, Unaffiliated Authors, Unaffiliated Authors and Unaffiliated Authors

detail.title: Consumer Resilience in the Face of Cascading Disasters: A Comparative Analysis of Marketing Adaptations from COVID-19 to Cyclone Ditwah in Sri Lanka.
detail.abstract: The global economic landscape has changed from one of volatility to one of "permacrisis" in which disasters are no longer isolated incidents but rather cascading realities. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of consumer behavior and marketing strategy adaptations in Sri Lanka during three distinct catastrophic phases: the COVID-19 pandemic (2020-2021), the Economic Crisis (2022-2023), and the recent "Ditwah Catastrophe" (Cyclone Ditwah, November 2025). This study argues that consumer behavior has evolved from "panic buying" driven by anxiety (COVID 19) to "survival consumption" driven by hyper-inflation (Economic Crisis), and finally to "displacement adaptability" driven by physical destruction (Cyclone Ditwah). The findings suggest that classic marketing mixes (4Ps) are no longer relevant in these settings. Instead, successful Sri Lankan firms have used a "Crisis-Response Marketing" (CRM) structure that includes flexible supply chains, empathy-driven communication, and "disaster philanthropy." This work contributes to the field by bridging the gap between psychological scarcity theories (such as Commodity Theory, TMT) and actual business continuity solutions in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了斯里兰卡在三个灾难阶段（COVID-19疫情、经济危机、Ditwah气旋）中消费者行为的演变，发现传统营销组合已失效，成功企业采用包含灵活供应链、共情沟通和"灾难慈善"的危机响应营销结构。
AI.research_question: 在"永久危机"背景下，斯里兰卡消费者行为如何演变？企业如何调整营销策略应对连续灾难？
AI.motivation: 全球经济从波动性转向"永久危机"，灾难不再是孤立事件而是连锁现实，需要研究消费者行为演变和企业营销策略适应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理稀缺理论（商品理论、恐惧管理理论TMT）与商业连续性解决方案的结合
AI.method: 对斯里兰卡三个灾难阶段（2020-2021 COVID-19疫情、2022-2023经济危机、2025年Ditwah气旋）的全面分析
AI.findings: 消费者行为从焦虑驱动的"恐慌性购买"（COVID-19）演变为高通胀驱动的"生存性消费"（经济危机），再到物理破坏驱动的"迁移适应性"（气旋）；传统4Ps营销组合失效，成功企业采用危机响应营销结构
AI.theory_contributions: 弥合心理稀缺理论与全球南方实际商业连续性解决方案之间的差距
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在连续灾难环境中提供危机响应营销框架，包括灵活供应链、共情驱动沟通和灾难慈善策略

title: When ESG Stops Signaling: Employer Attractiveness and the Limits of Corporate Responsibility in Institutionalized Sustainability Contexts
affiliations: and

detail.title: When ESG Stops Signaling: Employer Attractiveness and the Limits of Corporate Responsibility in Institutionalized Sustainability Contexts
detail.abstract: This study examines whether corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance functions as an effective signal of employer attractiveness in contexts where sustainability norms are highly institutionalized. Building on signaling theory, social identity theory, and research on corporate reputation, we argue that in high-ESG environments cross-sectional associations between ESG performance and employer attractiveness primarily reflect persistent differences across firms rather than marginal, managerially actionable effects. We test this argument using employer-attractiveness rankings from the Universum Talent Survey matched with firm-level ESG and financial data for publicly listed firms in Denmark, Finland, Norway, and Sweden over 2019-2023. Using an empirical design that separates between-firm from within-firm variation and accounts for missing data and sampling uncertainty, we document three findings. Firms with higher ESG performance are perceived as more attractive employers in cross-sectional comparisons, while within-firm changes in ESG performance do not translate into short-run changes in employer attractiveness. Employer attractiveness is positively associated with subsequent firm value, indicating that labor-market reputation represents a distinct and economically relevant asset.

AI.tldr: 在ESG高度制度化的北欧国家，企业ESG表现与雇主吸引力之间的横截面关联主要反映企业间的持久差异，而非边际可管理效应。研究发现：高ESG企业在横截面比较中更具雇主吸引力，但企业内部的ESG变化短期内不影响雇主吸引力；雇主吸引力能正向预测企业价值，表明劳动力市场声誉是独特的经济资产。
AI.research_question: 在可持续发展规范高度制度化的环境中，企业ESG表现是否作为雇主吸引力的有效信号？这种关联主要反映企业间的持久差异还是边际可管理效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍认为ESG表现能增强雇主吸引力，但缺乏对制度环境差异的考量。在ESG高度制度化的北欧国家，这种信号效应可能被削弱，因为所有企业都面临相似的ESG压力，ESG表现差异可能更多反映企业固有特征而非管理决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（解释ESG作为雇主吸引力信号）、社会认同理论（解释员工对高ESG企业的认同）、企业声誉理论（解释ESG与雇主品牌的关系）。
AI.method: 使用2019-2023年丹麦、芬兰、挪威、瑞典上市公司的数据，将Universum人才调查的雇主吸引力排名与企业ESG及财务数据匹配。采用分离企业间差异与企业内变化的实证设计，考虑缺失数据和抽样不确定性。
AI.findings: 1. 横截面比较中，高ESG企业确实被视为更具吸引力的雇主；2. 企业内部的ESG表现变化短期内不会转化为雇主吸引力的变化；3. 雇主吸引力正向预测后续企业价值，表明劳动力市场声誉是独特的经济资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了ESG信号效应的边界条件：在高度制度化的环境中，ESG与雇主吸引力的关联主要反映企业固有差异；2. 区分了企业间与企业内效应，深化了对ESG信号机制的理解；3. 将劳动力市场声誉概念化为独特的企业资产。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对管理者：在ESG高度制度化的环境中，单纯提升ESG评分可能无法快速改善雇主吸引力，需要更全面的雇主品牌建设；2. 对投资者：雇主吸引力可作为预测企业价值的指标；3. 对政策制定者：理解ESG制度化的不同影响。

detail.abstract: This study employs a systematic qualitative methodology to synthesize insights from 26 articles examining the theme "The End of the African Union is Nigh." The research investigates the challenges and crises facing the African Union (AU) as it grapples with issues such as political instability, economic dependency, and intra-continental conflicts. The initial step involves identifying relevant articles through a comprehensive literature online academic journals focusing on cultural studies, ecology, and education were utilized. Inclusion criteria focused on peer-reviewed articles, published in 1854 to 2016, that discussed, community engagement, and conservation efforts. Articles were screened for relevance based on titles and abstracts, followed by a full-text review to ensure they meet the criteria. Through qualitative analysis, the study identifies key factors contributing to the perceived decline of the AU, including its inability to effectively address member states' sovereignty concerns, the influence of external powers, and the lack of coherent policy frameworks. Findings reveal that while the AU was established to promote unity and cooperation among African nations, it has struggled to assert its authority in the face of rising nationalism and regional tensions. Themes such as inadequate funding, bureaucratic inefficiencies, and the challenge of achieving consensus among diverse member states emerge as significant barriers to its effectiveness. Furthermore, the study highlights the impact of external influences, which often undermine the AU's initiatives and exacerbate existing conflicts. This research underscores the urgent need for a re-evaluation of the AU's role and operational strategies to prevent its potential dissolution. By synthesizing perspectives from various studies, the findings aim to contribute to ongoing debates about the future of continental governance in Africa. Ultimately, this study advocates for innovative approaches that strengthen the AU's capacity to address contemporary challenges, ensuring its relevance and sustainability in an increasingly complex geopolitical landscape.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统定性方法综合分析了26篇关于"非洲联盟即将终结"主题的文章，揭示了非盟面临的政治不稳定、经济依赖、内部冲突等挑战，指出非盟在主权关切、外部势力影响和政策框架不连贯等方面的困境，并呼吁重新评估非盟角色和战略以防止其解体。
AI.research_question: 非洲联盟面临哪些挑战和危机，导致其被认为可能走向终结？
AI.motivation: 非洲联盟作为促进非洲国家团结与合作的重要组织，近年来面临诸多挑战和危机，存在可能解体的风险，需要系统分析其困境和问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域一体化理论、国际组织有效性理论、主权与治理理论、后殖民主义理论
AI.method: 系统性定性研究方法，综合分析了26篇相关文章，通过文献筛选（标题、摘要、全文审查）和定性分析识别关键主题和因素。
AI.findings: 研究发现非盟面临多重挑战：无法有效处理成员国主权关切、外部势力影响、缺乏连贯政策框架、资金不足、官僚效率低下、成员国多样性导致共识难以达成、民族主义抬头和地区紧张局势削弱其权威。

title: Switching the default: Acceptability and intended uptake of pre-booked appointments for COVID-19 vaccination
affiliations: , National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), , , Leiden University, National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) - Centre for Infectious Disease Control, Leiden University, National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) - Centre for Infectious Disease Control, , National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) - Corona Behavioral Unit and National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM)

detail.title: Switching the default: Acceptability and intended uptake of pre-booked appointments for COVID-19 vaccination
detail.abstract: BackgroundIn autumn 2023, COVID-19 vaccination invitations in the Netherlands shifted from self-scheduling to pre-booked appointments for selected groups. While defaulting to pre-booked slots may increase uptake, potential rebound effects remain unclear. We examine preferences between appointment types, their effect on vaccination intentions, and whether effects are different for individuals hestitant about this vaccination round.MethodsA mixed-methods approach was used to assess vaccination intentions for three groups (<60 with influenza vaccination indication, 60-69 and 70+ years) eligible for pre-booked appointments. A pilot study examined attitudes around pre-booked appointments in 15 interviews. The main study experimentally tested preferences for pre-booked appointments vs self-scheduled appointments and their effect on vaccination intentions in a representative online panel (n=1.886) and those who experience hesitancy about this vaccination.FindingsInterviews showed that pre-booked appointments are seen as presumptuous or inconvenient by some, but also as a useful aid in support of vaccination uptake, sometimes by the same people. Participants in the experiment indicated a preference for self-scheduling (Coefficient = -.23) but this preference did not translate to differences in vaccination intentions (Adjusted OR =1.11) Similar results were observed in the hesitant subgroup (Coefficient = –.25; Adjusted OR = 0.88).DiscussionIn our study pre-booked appointments do not change COVID-19 vaccination intentions. As pre-booked appointments evoked negative and positive sentiments and self-scheduling was found easier and more pleasant, it is important to examine potential rebound effects of switching the default, particularly amongst subgroups in the population with lower intentions.

AI.tldr: 荷兰研究发现，从自选预约转为预定时段预约的COVID-19疫苗接种邀请方式，虽然被一些人视为有用帮助，但总体上并未改变接种意愿。尽管参与者偏好自选预约，但两种方式对接种意愿无显著差异，在犹豫群体中也是如此。
AI.research_question: 预定时段预约与自选预约两种疫苗接种邀请方式对接种意愿有何影响？这种影响在疫苗接种犹豫群体中是否不同？
AI.motivation: 荷兰在2023年秋季将COVID-19疫苗接种邀请从自选预约改为预定时段预约，虽然默认预定时段可能提高接种率，但潜在的反弹效应尚不清楚，需要研究不同预约类型的偏好及其对接种意愿的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的默认选项理论（default option theory）和助推理论（nudge theory），以及疫苗接种行为决策理论。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：1）先导研究通过15个访谈探讨对预定时段预约的态度；2）主要研究通过代表性在线面板（n=1,886）进行实验，测试预定时段预约与自选预约的偏好及其对接种意愿的影响，特别关注疫苗接种犹豫群体。
AI.findings: 1）访谈显示预定时段预约被一些人视为冒昧或不方便，但也被视为支持疫苗接种的有用帮助；2）实验参与者偏好自选预约（系数=-0.23），但这种偏好并未转化为接种意愿的差异（调整OR=1.11）；3）在犹豫群体中观察到类似结果（系数=-0.25；调整OR=0.88）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）挑战了默认选项理论在疫苗接种预约场景中的普遍有效性；2）揭示了偏好与行为意图之间的脱节现象；3）为行为干预的边界条件提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为公共卫生政策制定者提供证据：预定时段预约并未改变接种意愿；2）建议在改变默认预约方式时需谨慎考虑潜在反弹效应；3）强调需要特别关注接种意愿较低的亚群体。

detail.abstract: The appeasement policy, historically utilised by political leaders to maintain stability and avoid conflict, poses significant threats to governance in Africa. This paper examined how appeasement characterized by concessions to powerful groups or political actors can undermine democratic institutions, exacerbate corruption, and perpetuate cycles of violence. In many African nations, leaders often resort to appeasement strategies to quell dissent or maintain power, prioritizing short-term stability over long-term governance reforms. This approach can create an environment where accountability is compromised, as political elites exploit concessions to entrench their positions while neglecting the needs of marginalized populations. The implications of this policy extend beyond individual governance; they affect national cohesion and democratic legitimacy. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the appeasement policy: a threat to governance in Africa. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 25 articles from 2003 to 2022 that discussed the appeasement policy: a threat to governance in Africa. Data was categorised as the appeasement policy: a threat to governance in Africa. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into appeasement policy: a threat to governance in Africa. Furthermore, it explores how the prioritization of political expediency over genuine reform can lead to social unrest, as disenfranchised groups react to unfulfilled promises and systemic inequalities. Ultimately, the paper argues for a re-evaluation of appeasement as a strategy within African governance. It advocates for proactive policies that prioritize transparency, accountability, and inclusivity, fostering resilient governance structures that address the underlying causes of conflict and promote sustainable development. By shifting the focus from appeasement to genuine engagement with all societal stakeholders, African nations can pave the way for more effective and equitable governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了非洲政治领导人为维持稳定和避免冲突而采取的绥靖政策如何破坏民主制度、加剧腐败并延续暴力循环。通过系统定性分析，研究发现绥靖政策优先考虑短期政治利益而非长期治理改革，损害问责制并加剧社会不平等。论文主张重新评估绥靖策略，转向透明、问责和包容的治理模式。
AI.research_question: 绥靖政策如何威胁非洲治理？具体而言，向强大群体或政治行为者做出让步的绥靖策略如何破坏民主制度、加剧腐败并延续暴力循环？
AI.motivation: 非洲许多国家的领导人经常采用绥靖策略来平息异议或维持权力，优先考虑短期稳定而非长期治理改革。这种做法可能破坏问责制，使政治精英利用让步巩固地位，同时忽视边缘化群体的需求。绥靖政策的影响超越个体治理，影响国家凝聚力和民主合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文基于政治绥靖理论、民主治理理论和冲突管理理论。主要理论框架包括：1）政治绥靖作为短期稳定策略的理论；2）民主制度脆弱性理论；3）腐败与权力巩固理论；4）社会不平等与冲突循环理论。
AI.method: 采用系统定性研究方法，收集和分析来自相关在线文献资源和专家意见的定性数据。筛选了2003年至2022年间讨论"绥靖政策：对非洲治理的威胁"的25篇同行评审文章。数据按主题分类，采用结构化分析方法。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）绥靖政策破坏民主制度，损害问责机制；2）加剧腐败，使政治精英利用让步巩固权力；3）延续暴力循环，因为边缘化群体的需求被忽视；4）优先政治权宜之计而非真正改革导致社会动荡；5）系统性不平等加剧社会分裂。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）扩展了绥靖理论在非洲治理背景下的应用；2）提出了"绥靖-治理恶化"的理论框架；3）丰富了民主脆弱性理论在非西方语境下的理解；4）发展了政治权宜与长期治理冲突的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）为非洲政策制定者提供重新评估绥靖策略的框架；2）倡导透明、问责和包容的治理政策；3）提出从绥靖转向真正社会参与的具体建议；4）为建立有韧性的治理结构提供指导；5）促进可持续发展和冲突预防的政策方向。

title: Borrowing Out of Pressure? The Spillover Effect of Cadre Recognition on Local Debt Issuance in China
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Political Science and

detail.title: Borrowing Out of Pressure? The Spillover Effect of Cadre Recognition on Local Debt Issuance in China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract: Local government debt is not a rare phenomenon in the contemporary world, while the tight connections between debt issuance, infrastructure construction, and land revenue generation make it a growing problem in China. However, existing literature has not adequately discussed how the non-economic shocks affect the debt issuance of local governments. With an originally constructed panel dataset of Chinese counties from 2012 to 2023, we try to find that the honor of Model County Party Secretary (MCPS), a non-monetary recognition by the Chinese central party-state to reward the outstanding county leaders, will bring about a spillover effect that drove the peers of the winners to issue urban investment bonds (UIB) more aggressively in the following years. Employing a Difference-inDifferences (DiD) model, we empirically test this hypothesis and find robust evidence of a spillover effect, despite the presence of an anticipation effect. The results remain significant across multiple robustness checks. Further analysis indicates that spillover effects are modestly stronger when MCPS winners remain in their positions for longer periods and are most pronounced among county leaders facing the greatest career anxiety. These findings highlight that even a policy designed to commend exemplary cadres may unintentionally encourage increased local debt issuance-an outcome shaped by the intense interregional competition inherent in China's bureaucratic system. This study contributes to explaining why the local debt accumulation in China persisted despite the frequent intervention from the central authority.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，中国县级政府官员获得"模范县委书记"荣誉后，会引发同级官员的模仿效应，导致他们更积极地发行城投债，这解释了为何中央干预下地方债务仍持续积累。
AI.research_question: 非经济冲击（如模范县委书记荣誉）如何影响地方政府债务发行？具体而言，模范县委书记荣誉是否会产生溢出效应，促使同级官员更积极地发行城投债？
AI.motivation: 地方政府债务在中国日益严重，现有文献未能充分探讨非经济冲击对地方债务发行的作用。中央对模范县委书记的表彰可能通过官僚体系内的区域竞争机制，意外地刺激债务增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于中国官僚体系中的区域竞争理论，官员面临晋升压力和职业焦虑时，会模仿成功同僚的行为。模范县委书记荣誉作为非货币性认可，可能通过信号传递和模仿机制影响同级官员的债务发行决策。
AI.method: 使用2012-2023年中国县级面板数据，采用双重差分模型（DiD）检验模范县委书记荣誉的溢出效应。进行多项稳健性检验，并进一步分析获奖官员任职时长和官员职业焦虑对效应强度的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 模范县委书记荣誉确实产生显著溢出效应，促使同级官员在后续年份更积极地发行城投债；2. 存在预期效应但溢出效应依然稳健；3. 获奖官员任职时间越长，溢出效应越强；4. 职业焦虑最高的县级官员表现出最强的模仿行为。

title: Green Credit and Bank Competitiveness in India: The Moderating Role of Bank Stability
affiliations: Institute of Management Technology (IMT), Hyderabad, XIM University and Ton Duc Thang University

detail.title: Green Credit and Bank Competitiveness in India: The Moderating Role of Bank Stability
detail.abstract: In the context of emerging economies, it is crucial to understand the influence of green credit on bank competitiveness to attain balance between environmental sustainability and bank stability. Present study investigates the impact of green credit on the competitiveness of banks in India along with the moderating influence of bank stability. 26 scheduled commercial banks with more than 80% share in Indian financial system is considered for the study period of 2010 to 2024 using twostep system GMM. Major findings of the study are that green credit diminishes competitiveness challenging existing literature. Stability of the banks has negative influence of the relationship between green credit and bank competitiveness. More stable banks experience greater competitive disadvantages, highlighting a paradox in which opportunity costs negate the advantages of bank stability. The impact was more significant among smaller banks, public sector banks and during Covid pandemic period. The findings of the study challenge the existing narrative of "win-win" outcomes associated with green credit in emerging markets and emphasize the importance of transition financing support in promoting green credit while ensuring bank competitiveness.

title: A New Shock and Little Room for Manoeuvre in Southern Africa
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: A New Shock and Little Room for Manoeuvre in Southern Africa
detail.abstract: This study examines the recent economic challenges faced by Southern Africa, particularly in the context of a new shock such as the COVID-19 pandemic, climate change impacts, and geopolitical tensions that have compounded existing vulnerabilities. The region, characterized by high levels of poverty and inequality, is experiencing limited fiscal space and diminished capacity for policy manoeuvring in addressing these multifaceted crises. This study employs a systematic qualitative method and analysed 23 academic journals from 2007 to 2025 focussing on the economic impacts of recent shocks on Southern Africa, focusing on governance, socioeconomic vulnerabilities, and policy responses. The study themes were around economic shocks, governance structures, and socioeconomic implications. Drawing on a comprehensive analysis of economic data and policy responses, the research identifies key factors that exacerbate the region's challenges, including reliance on commodity exports, insufficient diversification, and weak governance structures. The findings reveal that the combination of external shocks and internal structural weaknesses has resulted in a precarious economic situation, where governments are often forced to prioritize immediate fiscal concerns over long-term development goals. As public debt levels rise and social spending is constrained, the implications for economic stability, social equity, and growth are significant. This study emphasizes the urgent need for integrated policy responses that focus on enhancing resilience through diversification, improving governance, and fostering stakeholder engagement. By providing insights into the current economic landscape and the limited room for manoeuvre, this research aims to inform policymakers and stakeholders about the critical need for comprehensive strategies that can effectively address both immediate shocks and underlying vulnerabilities in Southern Africa. Ultimately, the study advocates for a proactive approach to build sustainable and resilient economies in the face of ongoing and future challenges.

title: Motivation without Mind: Motivation as an Emergent Property of Evolutionary Allocation
affiliations: St. Edwards University

detail.title: Motivation without Mind: Motivation as an Emergent Property of Evolutionary Allocation
detail.abstract: Motivation theories in management research overwhelmingly assume that effort allocation is rooted in conscious or psychologically represented states-needs, goals, valuations, and internalized meanings. This paper challenges that foundational premise by proposing the Unconscious Motivational Evolution Model (UMEM), a minimal evolutionary framework that identifies a deeper, pre-psychological layer of motivation. UMEM conceptualizes motivation not as a mental state but as a heritable behavioral propensity governing how agents allocate limited energy across competing tasks. Through a stylized evolutionary simulation, we show that adaptive, coherent, and directionally consistent behavioral patterns emerge even in agents with no cognition, no representational capacity, and no internal reward system. These patterns resemble core motivational phenomena studied in organizational behavior, including effort redirection under changing conditions, persistence despite low returns, and the survival of seemingly non-functional behaviors. We further incorporate a simple cognitive module to examine how cognition interacts with inherited behavioral propensities. Results reveal that cognition does not generate motivation; rather, it distorts, accelerates, or stabilizes the expression of underlying tendencies. This mechanism offers new explanations for several puzzles in motivational research, such as inconsistent responses to incentives, variability in intrinsic-extrinsic trade-offs, and the limits of self-report-based assessments of motivation. UMEM contributes to management theory by (a) identifying unconscious behavioral propensity as a foundational construct beneath existing motivational frameworks, (b) providing a mechanistic account of how motivational patterns emerge and persist across environments, and (c) offering an integrative foundation that links organizational behavior, evolutionary reasoning, and emerging research in artificial intelligence. The model reframes motivation as an evolutionary substrate upon which psychological interpretations are layered, opening new pathways for theorizing effort, persistence, and behavioral diversity in organizations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了无意识动机进化模型(UMEM)，挑战了传统动机理论认为努力分配源于意识状态的前提。通过进化模拟表明，即使在没有认知能力的智能体中，也能涌现出类似动机现象的行为模式。认知不产生动机，而是扭曲、加速或稳定底层行为倾向的表达。
AI.research_question: 动机是否必须源于意识或心理状态？是否存在更深层的、前心理的动机基础？认知如何与这种底层动机倾向相互作用？
AI.motivation: 传统管理研究中的动机理论普遍假设努力分配源于意识或心理状态（需求、目标、价值观等）。该论文挑战这一基础前提，探索是否存在更深层的、前心理的动机基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无意识动机进化模型(UMEM)：将动机概念化为可遗传的行为倾向，而非心理状态。该模型基于进化框架，强调动机作为能量分配的行为倾向在进化中形成。
AI.method: 采用程式化的进化模拟方法，研究无认知、无表征能力、无内部奖励系统的智能体如何涌现出适应性的行为模式。随后加入简单认知模块，探索认知与遗传行为倾向的相互作用。
AI.findings:
1. 即使在没有认知能力的智能体中，也能涌现出适应、连贯、方向一致的行为模式，类似于组织行为学中的核心动机现象。
2. 认知不产生动机，而是扭曲、加速或稳定底层行为倾向的表达。
3. 该机制解释了激励反应不一致、内在-外在权衡的变异性等动机研究难题。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将无意识行为倾向确定为现有动机框架下的基础建构。
2. 提供了动机模式如何在环境中涌现和持续的机制性解释。
3. 提供了连接组织行为、进化推理和人工智能研究的整合基础。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为激励设计提供了新视角，解释了为什么激励措施有时会失效。
2. 挑战了基于自我报告的动机评估方法的局限性。
3. 为理解组织中的努力、坚持和行为多样性提供了新框架。

title: Distinct, Overlapping, and Interconnected Domains of Public Policy in Africa
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Distinct, Overlapping, and Interconnected Domains of Public Policy in Africa
detail.abstract: This paper explores the distinct, overlapping, and interconnected domains of public policy in Africa, highlighting the complexities and interdependencies that characterize governance on the continent. As African nations confront a myriad of challenges ranging from economic development to social justice and environmental sustainability, understanding the multifaceted nature of public policy becomes essential for effective governance. The research begins by delineating the key domains of public policy, including economic, social, environmental, and health policies. Each domain is analysed for its unique objectives and mechanisms, while also emphasizing how they overlap and influence one another. For instance, economic policies often impact social outcomes, and environmental policies may affect public health, creating a web of interrelated issues that require integrated approaches. The study meticulously selected 29 peer-reviewed articles spanning from 1965 to 2018, each discussing the Distinct, Overlapping, and Interconnected Domains of Public Policy in Africa. The study revealed how policymakers navigate these complexities in practice. This research study highlights successful examples where coordinated efforts across multiple domains have led to improved outcomes, as well as instances where siloed approaches have resulted in inefficiencies and policy failures. Furthermore, the study addresses the challenges of fragmentation in public policy, such as lack of communication between sectors, misalignment of goals, and insufficient stakeholder engagement. It advocates for a systems-thinking approach that recognizes the interconnectedness of policy domains and promotes collaboration among governmental, civil society, and private sector actors. In conclusion, this paper argues that addressing the distinct, overlapping, and interconnected domains of public policy is crucial for fostering holistic and sustainable development in Africa. By encouraging integrated policymaking and collaboration, the findings aim to inform scholars, practitioners, and policymakers about the necessity of adaptive frameworks that can effectively respond to the continent's dynamic challenges and opportunities.

detail.abstract: This study explores the evolution of public debt vulnerabilities in lower-income economies of Southern Africa, focusing on the interplay between external economic pressures, governance challenges, and policy responses. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the Evolution of Public Debt Vulnerabilities in Lower Income Economies of Southern Africa. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peerreviewed 22 articles from 1989 to 2025 that discussed the Evolution of Public Debt Vulnerabilities in Lower Income Economies of Southern Africa. Data was categorised as the limits of western leadership theory in East Asia and Africa. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into the Evolution of Public Debt Vulnerabilities in Lower Income Economies of Southern Africa, driven by factors such as reliance on commodity exports, external borrowing, and the impacts of global economic fluctuations. Countries like Mozambique and Zambia exemplify the increasing debt burdens, exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic, which further strained fiscal resources and highlighted existing vulnerabilities. The findings indicate that weak governance structures, characterized by corruption and inadequate institutional capacity, have hindered effective debt management and fiscal policy implementation. This research underscores the necessity for tailored policy responses that prioritize sustainable debt management practices and promote economic diversification to mitigate vulnerabilities. Additionally, the study emphasizes the importance of strengthening institutional frameworks and enhancing stakeholder engagement in fiscal decision-making processes. By providing a nuanced understanding of the factors contributing to public debt vulnerabilities, this study aims to inform policymakers and stakeholders about the critical need for comprehensive reforms. Ultimately, addressing the challenges of public debt in lowerincome economies of Southern Africa is essential for fostering economic stability and supporting sustainable development in the region.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了南部非洲低收入经济体公共债务脆弱性的演变，重点关注外部经济压力、治理挑战和政策应对之间的相互作用。研究发现，商品出口依赖、外部借款和全球经济波动等因素加剧了债务脆弱性，而薄弱的治理结构阻碍了有效的债务管理。研究强调需要制定可持续债务管理和经济多元化的定制政策。
AI.research_question: 南部非洲低收入经济体公共债务脆弱性如何演变？外部经济压力、治理挑战和政策应对之间如何相互作用影响债务脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 南部非洲低收入经济体面临日益增长的公共债务负担，特别是COVID-19大流行加剧了财政压力。这些国家依赖商品出口、外部借款，并受全球经济波动影响，同时存在治理结构薄弱问题，需要深入理解这些因素如何相互作用导致债务脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 西方领导力理论在东亚和非洲的局限性；公共债务管理理论；治理与制度能力理论；经济多元化理论
AI.method: 系统性定性研究方法，通过结构化方法收集和分析来自相关在线文献来源和专家意见的定性数据。选择了1989年至2025年间22篇同行评审文章，重点关注讨论南部非洲低收入经济体公共债务脆弱性演变的文献。

title: The Fairness Trilemma: An Impossibility Theorem for Algorithmic Governance in Housing Credit
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title: The Fairness Trilemma: An Impossibility Theorem for Algorithmic Governance in Housing Credit
detail.abstract: Mortgage underwriting and tenant-screening algorithms have become gatekeepers to housing credit and homeownership, yet they produce persistent disparities across racial and ethnic groups. This paper models the governance of such algorithms as a social-choice problem. In a stylized housing-credit environment with two groups, two algorithms (profit-maximizing and fairness-constrained), and four stakeholders (group representatives, lender, regulator), I establish an Arrow-style impossibility theorem: no social choice rule over algorithm selection can simultaneously satisfy Pareto efficiency, an anti-discrimination symmetry axiom, and a non-trivial minority-representation requirement.[1][2] The result clarifies that fairness in algorithm selection requires choosing which desiderata to relax-efficiency, formal symmetry, or robust representation-rather than expecting a single governance mechanism to satisfy all three. The analysis connects computational social choice, discrimination economics, and algorithmic fairness, with implications for mortgage underwriting, tenant screening, and algorithmic redlining in property technology.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了一个算法治理的社会选择模型，证明了在住房信贷环境中，算法选择无法同时满足帕累托效率、反歧视对称性和少数群体代表性要求，形成了类似阿罗不可能定理的结果。
AI.research_question: 在住房信贷算法治理中，是否存在一种社会选择规则能够同时满足效率、公平和代表性要求？
AI.motivation: 抵押贷款承销和租客筛选算法已成为住房信贷和房屋所有权的守门人，但这些算法在不同种族和族裔群体间产生了持续的不平等。需要理解算法治理中的基本权衡。

AI.method: 理论建模方法：在简化的住房信贷环境中建立形式化模型，包含两个群体、两种算法（利润最大化算法和公平约束算法）和四个利益相关者（群体代表、贷款人、监管者）。
AI.findings: 证明了一个类似阿罗不可能定理的结果：不存在任何算法选择的社会选择规则能够同时满足帕累托效率、反歧视对称性和非平凡的少数群体代表性要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将算法治理问题形式化为社会选择问题；2. 建立了连接计算社会选择、歧视经济学和算法公平的理论框架；3. 揭示了算法公平治理中的基本不可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了清晰的权衡框架：必须在效率、形式对称性和稳健代表性之间做出选择；2. 对抵押贷款承销、租客筛选和房地产技术中的算法红线问题具有实际启示；3. 挑战了单一治理机制能满足所有公平要求的期望。

detail.title:
The Equation of Loss-Cutting: Toward an Intelligent Control Beyond Blind Spots 
Transition from Static Equilibrium to Stochastic Dynamics under JX Theory
detail.abstract:
This paper presents an applied formulation of the loss-cutting equation under JX Theory, a unified framework for decision-making in volatile and structurally asymmetric environments. The model reconceptualizes loss-cutting not as a reac- tive response to short-term negative outcomes, but as an intelligent operation for preserving future freedom ∆F.

The decision score
L(x) = R(x) − S(x) − E(x) − λσ2(x) + φ∆F(x)

captures the dynamic balance between expected return, structural burden, execu- tion error, volatility exposure, and remaining flexibility. A negative transition of L(x) indicates not deterministic failure, but a collapse in optionality, making con- tinuation suboptimal compared to a controlled exit.

To evaluate long-term alignment, we introduce the cumulative equilibrium score J(t) = αE(t) + βS(t) + γA(t),

which tracks how emotional cost, structural load, and anticipatory suppression evolve across sequences of decisions. Applications across finance, education, or- ganizational dynamics, and AI ethics demonstrate that loss-cutting functions as a generative mechanism: a strategic reshaping of the future decision space rather than a short-term concession.

AI.tldr: 本文基于JX理论提出了一个损失切割方程的应用公式，将损失切割重新概念化为保护未来自由度ΔF的智能操作，而非对短期负面结果的被动反应。该模型通过决策得分L(x)和累积均衡得分J(t)来评估决策的长期对齐性，并在金融、教育、组织动态和AI伦理等领域展示了应用价值。
AI.research_question: 在波动性和结构不对称的环境中，如何将损失切割重新概念化为保护未来决策自由度的智能操作，而非对短期负面结果的被动反应？
AI.motivation: 传统决策理论通常将损失切割视为对短期负面结果的被动反应，但在波动性和结构不对称的环境中，这种观点过于简化。需要一个新的框架来理解损失切割作为保护未来决策自由度的战略操作。
AI.theoretical_framework: JX理论（决策制定的统一框架），强调在波动性和结构不对称环境中的决策制定。核心概念包括：未来自由度ΔF、决策得分L(x)、累积均衡得分J(t)。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：1）提出决策得分公式L(x)=R(x)-S(x)-E(x)-λσ²(x)+φΔF(x)；2）引入累积均衡得分J(t)=αE(t)+βS(t)+γA(t)；3）在金融、教育、组织动态和AI伦理等领域进行应用验证。
AI.findings: 1）损失切割应被视为保护未来自由度的生成机制；2）决策得分L(x)的负向转变表示可选性的崩溃而非确定性失败；3）累积均衡得分J(t)能有效追踪决策序列中的情感成本、结构负荷和预期抑制的演变；4）该框架在多个领域都显示出应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将损失切割重新概念化为战略性的未来决策空间重塑；2）提出了包含未来自由度ΔF的决策得分模型；3）发展了评估决策长期对齐性的累积均衡得分框架；4）扩展了JX理论在波动性和结构不对称环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融投资中的止损决策提供新视角；2）为教育系统中的资源分配决策提供框架；3）为组织动态中的战略调整提供指导；4）为AI伦理中的算法决策制定提供理论支持；5）帮助决策者区分短期损失和长期可选性崩溃。

detail.abstract: Climate change increasingly manifests through public health crises, yet prevailing policy responses often treat climate impacts, health outcomes, and human rights obligations as separate domains. This paper examines their intersection by conceptualizing climate-related health harms as violations of internationally protected human rights. It argues that climate change undermines the enjoyment of the rights to health, life, food, water, and a healthy environment, particularly among marginalized and climate-vulnerable populations. Drawing on international human rights law, global public health frameworks, and climate governance literature, the paper develops an integrated analytical model linking state human rights obligations to climate-responsive public health action. It demonstrates how rights-based approaches can enhance prevention, adaptation, and accountability by embedding equity, participation, and non-discrimination into climate and health policies. The analysis further explores implications for health system resilience, legal remedies, and international cooperation in the context of transboundary climate risks. The paper contributes to emerging interdisciplinary scholarship by proposing a normative and operational framework for aligning climate governance with public health protection through enforceable human rights standards.

title: Analyzing the Impact of the Ambazonia Conflict on Cameroon's Agricultural Value Chains
affiliations: Saint Monica University

detail.title: Analyzing the Impact of the Ambazonia Conflict on Cameroon's Agricultural Value Chains
detail.abstract: This study investigates the systemic erosion of the agricultural sector in Cameroon resulting from the protracted "Ambazonia" independence struggle. Utilizing a mixedmethods approach-integrating 2025 field assessments with Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) modeling-the research quantifies the transition from a productive regional economy to a fragmented war economy. Results indicate that annual agricultural losses have escalated to over US$1 billion, with critical commodities (cocoa, palm oil, and rubber) experiencing production declines of 40% to 100% in conflict zones. The analysis further explores the "ghost town" phenomenon as a unique labor-supply shock and assesses the long-term implications for national GDP and regional food sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本研究量化了喀麦隆"安巴佐尼亚"独立斗争对农业部门的系统性侵蚀，发现年损失超10亿美元，冲突区关键商品产量下降40-100%，揭示了从生产性区域经济向碎片化战争经济的转变。
AI.research_question: 喀麦隆"安巴佐尼亚"独立斗争如何系统性地侵蚀农业部门，以及这种侵蚀对区域经济和粮食主权产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 理解长期冲突对农业部门的系统性影响，量化战争经济转型的后果，为冲突地区的农业恢复和粮食安全政策提供依据。

title: The Economic Impact of the Ambazonia War of Independence on the Cameroon Economy
affiliations: Saint Monica University

detail.title: The Economic Impact of the Ambazonia War of Independence on the Cameroon Economy
detail.abstract: The Ambazonia conflict has profoundly affected Cameroon's economy since its escalation in 2016. Originating from grievances over marginalization in the English-speaking Northwest and Southwest regions, the war has led to widespread disruption, including infrastructure destruction, population displacement, and sectoral collapses (International Crisis Group, 2019). This paper examines the multifaceted economic repercussions, drawing on reports from international organizations and local assessments. Key findings include a significant downgrade in GDP growth, massive losses in agriculture and other key sectors, increased public debt, and long-term social costs that exacerbate economic stagnation. Post-2025 projections indicate moderate growth recovery, averaging around 4% annually through 2030, contingent on conflict resolution and structural reforms. The analysis underscores the need for resolution to restore economic stability.

AI.tldr: 喀麦隆的Ambazonia冲突自2016年升级以来对经济造成深远影响，导致GDP增长大幅下调、农业等关键部门大规模损失、公共债务增加，以及加剧经济停滞的长期社会成本。2025年后预测显示，在冲突解决和结构改革的前提下，经济增长将适度恢复至年均4%左右。
AI.research_question: Ambazonia冲突对喀麦隆经济产生了哪些多方面的经济影响？
AI.motivation: Ambazonia冲突自2016年升级以来已对喀麦隆经济造成深远影响，包括基础设施破坏、人口流离失所和部门崩溃，但对其具体经济后果的系统分析仍然不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于冲突经济学理论，分析内战对经济发展的影响机制，包括基础设施破坏、人力资本损失、投资环境恶化等渠道。
AI.method: 采用文献分析和数据综合方法，基于国际组织报告（如国际危机集团2019年报告）和当地评估文件，对冲突的经济影响进行多维度分析。
AI.findings: 主要发现包括：GDP增长显著下调、农业等关键部门大规模损失、公共债务增加、长期社会成本加剧经济停滞。2025年后预测显示，在冲突解决和结构改革的前提下，经济增长将适度恢复至年均4%左右。
AI.theory_contributions: 为冲突经济学提供了具体案例研究，展示了地区性冲突如何通过多重渠道影响国家整体经济表现，并验证了冲突解决与经济增长恢复之间的关联性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为喀麦隆政策制定者提供了冲突经济影响的量化评估，强调了冲突解决对经济稳定的必要性，并为国际援助和重建计划提供了实证基础。
