detail.title: Deterministic Margin Model (DMM) for Bilateral Contract Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is original work. The Deterministic Margin Model (DMM) and related contract structures were developed by me and are implemented in the Verslan protocol. www.verslan.com
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on theoretical modeling informed by my prior trading experience. No human subjects, client data, or personally identifiable information were used in this research.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Deterministic Margin Model (DMM), a margining and settlement framework for bilateral contract markets in which all potential losses are fully contained within pre-posted margin. Each participant posts mandatory initial margin at inception and may optionally add variable margin over the life of the trade; margining may be asymmetric across counterparties. At all times, the maximum possible loss of any participant is bounded by their posted margin, and all obligations are satisfied using escrowed funds alone. No margin calls, external capital injections, or mutualized default funds are required, and settlement remains deterministic under all admissible outcomes.

AI.tldr: 确定性保证金模型（DMM）是一种双边合约市场的保证金和结算框架，确保所有潜在损失完全包含在预先发布的保证金内，无需追加保证金、外部资本注入或共同违约基金。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个双边合约市场的保证金和结算框架，确保所有潜在损失完全包含在预先发布的保证金内，消除追加保证金、外部资本注入和共同违约基金的需求？
AI.motivation: 传统保证金系统存在追加保证金、外部资本依赖和违约风险共担等问题，需要一种更安全、确定性的保证金框架来降低系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 确定性保证金模型（DMM）理论框架，基于预先发布保证金、可选可变保证金、非对称保证金机制和托管资金结算等核心概念。
AI.method: 提出确定性保证金模型（DMM）的理论框架设计，包括初始保证金要求、可选可变保证金机制、非对称保证金安排和托管资金结算系统。
AI.findings: DMM框架确保所有参与者的最大可能损失受限于其已发布的保证金，所有义务仅使用托管资金即可满足，结算在所有可接受结果下保持确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了确定性保证金模型的理论框架，为双边合约市场提供了一种无需追加保证金、外部资本注入或共同违约基金的完整保证金解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和监管机构提供了一种更安全、确定性的保证金管理方案，可降低系统性风险，简化结算流程，提高市场稳定性。

title: Elite Legal Power and the Architecture of Accountability: The Ruemmler Case in Context
affiliations: Lebanese University

detail.title: Elite Legal Power and the Architecture of Accountability: The Ruemmler Case in Context
detail.abstract: Purpose: This study examines how institutional power structures constrain transparency and accountability in the aftermath of the Jeffrey Epstein scandal, with Kathy Ruemmler serving as a case study illustrating elite legal professionals' role in managing disclosure boundaries. The research addresses why comprehensive accountability remains elusive despite unprecedented public scrutiny and documentary evidence. Study design/methodology/approach: The analysis employs a structural and political lens, examining email correspondence records, legal privilege invocations, institutional responses, and survivor coalition mobilization strategies. The methodology focuses on institutional mechanisms rather than individual culpability, analyzing how legal frameworks, privilege doctrines, and elite networks intersect to enable selective transparency. Findings: The research demonstrates that accountability after Epstein reflects entrenched power configurations where legal expertise functions as both an institutional asset and a transparency barrier. Elite legal professionals utilize attorney-client privilege, procedural delays, and strategic disclosure to manage reputational risk while preserving institutional continuity. Ruemmler's maintained corporate leadership despite extensive documented Epstein communications exemplifies network resilience and the asymmetry between institutional protection mechanisms and survivor-led accountability demands. Originality/value: This study reframes post-scandal accountability as political contestation rather than an inevitable legal process, foregrounding survivor coalitions as disruptive political actors rather than passive victims. It reveals how transparency is conditional on power relations rather than flowing from legal obligation, challenging assumptions that institutions inherently incline toward openness when confronted with elite wrongdoing. The analysis contributes to democratic theory by exposing fundamental tensions between bottom-up demands for truth and top-down containment mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了杰弗里·爱泼斯坦丑闻后，制度权力结构如何限制透明度和问责制。以凯西·鲁姆勒为案例，揭示了精英法律专业人士在管理信息披露边界中的作用，说明为何在公众监督和证据充分的情况下，全面问责仍然难以实现。
AI.research_question: 在杰弗里·爱泼斯坦丑闻后，制度权力结构如何限制透明度和问责制？为什么在史无前例的公众监督和大量证据面前，全面问责仍然难以实现？
AI.motivation: 尽管爱泼斯坦丑闻引发了前所未有的公众关注和大量证据披露，但全面的问责仍然难以实现。这促使研究者探究制度权力结构如何通过法律框架、特权原则和精英网络来限制透明度和问责制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用结构和政治视角，分析制度机制而非个人责任。关注法律框架、特权原则（如律师-客户特权）、精英网络与制度权力结构的交叉作用，以及幸存者联盟作为政治行动者的角色。
AI.method: 分析电子邮件通信记录、法律特权援引、制度回应和幸存者联盟动员策略。采用制度机制分析方法，而非个人责任追究，重点关注法律框架、特权原则和精英网络的相互作用。
AI.findings: 研究表明，爱泼斯坦丑闻后的问责反映了根深蒂固的权力配置，其中法律专业知识既是制度资产也是透明度障碍。精英法律专业人士利用律师-客户特权、程序延迟和策略性披露来管理声誉风险，同时保持制度连续性。鲁姆勒在大量爱泼斯坦通信记录曝光后仍能保持企业领导地位，体现了网络韧性和制度保护机制与幸存者问责需求之间的不对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将丑闻后问责重新定义为政治竞争而非必然的法律过程；将幸存者联盟定位为破坏性政治行动者而非被动受害者；揭示透明度取决于权力关系而非法律义务，挑战了制度在面对精英不当行为时天生倾向于开放的假设；为民主理论做出贡献，揭示了自下而上的真相需求与自上而下的控制机制之间的根本张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了精英法律专业人士如何利用法律特权和管理策略来限制问责；为理解制度如何应对丑闻提供了分析框架；强调了幸存者联盟作为政治行动者的重要性；对改革法律框架和问责机制提供了实践启示。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Brain: Is Innovation Getting Easier?
affiliations: Michigan State University - Department of Economics, Tsinghua University, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of International Trade and Economics and Department of Economics, Michigan State University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Brain: Is Innovation Getting Easier?
detail.abstract: We develop an endogenous growth model that distinguishes the roles of artificial intelligence (AI) and the brain in innovation. AI refines existing knowledge into a usable base, and then the brain recombines it into new ideas. AI alleviates the brain's knowledge burdens, but by selectively discarding information, AI weakens the brain's ability to create knowledge spillovers. Consequently, the refined-knowledge stock responds nonmonotonically to the quality of AI, potentially wasting social intelligence. Faster AI progress raises long-run growth; yet its effects on research productivity and the R&D labor share are ambiguous. We characterize the conditions under which AI makes innovation easier.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个内生增长模型，区分了人工智能和大脑在创新中的不同作用。AI将现有知识提炼为可用基础，大脑则将其重新组合为新想法。AI减轻了大脑的知识负担，但通过选择性丢弃信息，削弱了大脑创造知识溢出的能力。因此，提炼后的知识存量对AI质量呈非单调响应，可能导致社会智力浪费。更快的AI进步提高了长期增长，但对研究生产率和研发劳动力份额的影响不明确。研究描述了AI使创新更容易的条件。
AI.research_question: AI和大脑在创新过程中分别扮演什么角色？AI如何影响知识创造、知识溢出和长期经济增长？在什么条件下AI能使创新变得更容易？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展，理解AI如何改变创新过程变得至关重要。传统创新理论未充分区分AI和人类大脑在知识创造中的不同作用，需要新的理论框架来分析AI对创新动态和经济增长的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长理论，特别关注知识创造和创新的微观基础。模型区分了AI的知识提炼功能和大脑的知识重组功能，强调两者在创新过程中的互补性和潜在冲突。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建内生增长模型。模型包含AI和大脑两个知识处理主体，分析它们如何相互作用影响知识存量、创新率和经济增长。
AI.findings: 1. AI通过提炼知识减轻大脑负担，但选择性丢弃信息削弱了知识溢出效应；2. 提炼后的知识存量对AI质量呈非单调响应；3. 更快的AI进步提高长期经济增长率；4. AI对研究生产率和研发劳动力份额的影响不确定；5. 存在特定条件使AI真正促进创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了区分AI和大脑创新角色的理论框架；2. 揭示了AI在知识处理中的双重效应（减轻负担vs削弱溢出）；3. 解释了知识存量对AI的非单调响应；4. 丰富了内生增长理论中对AI作用的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计AI创新政策提供理论依据；2. 帮助企业理解AI在研发中的最佳应用方式；3. 警示AI可能导致社会智力浪费的风险；4. 指导如何平衡AI效率和知识溢出效应。

title: Threatened, Mobilized, Distrustful: Social Trust in Ukraine's War Context
affiliations: Kyiv School of Economics

detail.title: Threatened, Mobilized, Distrustful: Social Trust in Ukraine's War Context

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human or animal subjects and therefore did not require ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was conducted without any financial support from public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agencies.

detail.abstract: Social trust constitutes a central component of social cohesion, a key determinant of economic development, and a foundational element of stable and effective democratic systems. Exposure to violence can undermine trust by disrupting collective cooperation and altering the established patterns of social interaction. This study uses the ongoing Russian-Ukrainian war to explore how social trust changes during conflict, while distinguishing between two primary influences-ideological and experiential. The former are defined as individuals' alignment with wartime ideologies. The latter are limited to perceived deteriorations in personal safety and mental health caused by experiences of violence. The analysis is based on structural equation modelling, using data collected from 1,224 respondents through an online survey conducted in 2024. The findings show that experiential influences erode trust not only directly but also indirectly, mainly through reduced confidence in state institutions. Ideological influences provide a partial buffer against these negative consequences, insufficient, however, to offset them. As a result, the net effect of the war on social trust remains negative and sizeable among Ukrainians.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨俄乌战争如何影响社会信任，区分意识形态和体验两种影响机制。研究发现体验影响（个人安全感和心理健康恶化）会直接和间接（通过削弱对政府机构的信任）侵蚀社会信任，而意识形态影响（战时意识形态认同）只能部分缓冲这种负面影响，但不足以抵消。战争对乌克兰人社会信任的净效应仍是显著负面的。
AI.research_question: 俄乌战争如何影响社会信任？具体来说，意识形态影响（个人对战时意识形态的认同）和体验影响（个人安全感和心理健康恶化）如何分别影响社会信任？
AI.motivation: 社会信任是社会凝聚力的核心组成部分，对经济发展和民主稳定至关重要。暴力冲突可能破坏信任，但具体机制尚不清楚。俄乌战争提供了一个独特的研究机会，可以区分意识形态和体验两种影响机制，理解冲突中社会信任的动态变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会信任理论、冲突心理学和制度信任理论。区分两种影响机制：意识形态影响（个人对战时意识形态的认同）和体验影响（暴力经历导致个人安全感和心理健康恶化）。假设体验影响会侵蚀信任，而意识形态影响可能起到缓冲作用。
AI.method: 采用结构方程模型分析2024年在线调查收集的1,224名受访者数据。通过问卷调查测量社会信任、意识形态认同、个人安全感、心理健康状况以及对政府机构的信任等变量。
AI.findings: 体验影响不仅直接侵蚀社会信任，还通过削弱对政府机构的信任间接降低社会信任。意识形态影响能部分缓冲这些负面影响，但不足以完全抵消。总体而言，战争对乌克兰人社会信任的净效应是显著负面的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确区分了冲突中影响社会信任的两种机制：意识形态影响和体验影响；2. 揭示了体验影响通过制度信任中介的间接作用路径；3. 验证了意识形态影响的缓冲作用有限，无法完全抵消体验的负面影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为冲突地区的社会重建政策提供依据，强调需要同时关注心理创伤修复和制度信任重建；2. 表明单纯依靠意识形态动员不足以维持社会信任，需要实质性的安全保障和心理健康支持；3. 为国际组织在冲突地区的干预提供理论指导。

title: Ex-post And Ex-ante Analysis of Feasibility for PV Solar Projects in Uzbekistan: Financial Modelling Aspects
affiliations: Westminster International University in Tashkent (WIUT), Westminster International University in Tashkent (WIUT), Westminster International University in Tashkent (WIUT), Gulistan state university  and The State University of Management - Department of Economic measurements

detail.title: Ex-post And Ex-ante Analysis of Feasibility for PV Solar Projects in Uzbekistan: Financial Modelling Aspects
detail.abstract: Uzbekistan has rapidly expanded solar photovoltaic (PV) capacity as part of its transition toward a low-carbon energy system, supported by guaranteed purchase tariffs and an evolving regulatory framework. This paper evaluates the economic feasibility of solar PV investments in Uzbekistan through a combined ex-post and ex-ante analysis, focusing on both commercial-scale rooftop installations and a proposed large utility-scale floating photovoltaic (FPV) project. Ex-post performance data from three commercial rooftop PV systems in Tashkent (20-175 kW) over the period 2024-2025 are analysed using full-lifecycle investment appraisal metrics, including Equivalent Uniform Annual Cost (EUAC), Net Present Value (NPV), and Internal Rate of Return (IRR), to benchmark real operating outcomes against modelled expectations. These results are then used to calibrate ex-ante simulations for a 491 MW FPV installation planned on the Sardoba reservoir, assessed using RETScreen Expert and a bespoke three-statement financial model incorporating detailed tax, financing, and operational assumptions. The findings indicate that commercial-scale rooftop PV projects in Tashkent operate close to the financial break-even point, with EUAC-based levelized costs broadly aligned with current guaranteed purchase prices for PV electricity, resulting in marginally negative or near-zero NPVs. In contrast, the large-scale Sardoba FPV project demonstrates moderate but positive financial viability, with nominal IRRs of approximately 14-16% and payback periods under ten years at the prevailing tariff levels. Importantly, the monetized value of environmental externalities-primarily avoided CO₂ emissions-amounts to roughly 25% of initial capital expenditure, materially enhancing the project's overall economic value. The results suggest that while large-scale solar projects in Uzbekistan generate limited private financial rents, their societal benefits justify continued policy support, stopping short of additional direct subsidy disbursements, but conducive of lower cost-of-capital measures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过事后和事前分析评估乌兹别克斯坦太阳能光伏投资的经济可行性，发现商业屋顶光伏项目接近盈亏平衡点，而大型浮动光伏项目具有适度正财务可行性，环境外部性价值显著增强项目经济价值。
AI.research_question: 乌兹别克斯坦太阳能光伏投资的经济可行性如何？商业屋顶光伏与大型浮动光伏项目的财务表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 乌兹别克斯坦正快速扩大太阳能光伏容量以实现低碳能源转型，但需要评估不同类型光伏项目的经济可行性，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资评估理论（全生命周期成本分析）、财务分析框架（NPV、IRR、EUAC）、环境外部性估值理论
AI.method: 结合事后和事前分析：1）事后分析：使用EUAC、NPV、IRR等指标分析塔什干三个商业屋顶光伏系统（20-175kW）2024-2025年运营数据；2）事前分析：使用RETScreen Expert和定制财务报表模型评估Sardoba水库491MW浮动光伏项目，考虑税收、融资和运营假设
AI.findings: 1）塔什干商业屋顶光伏项目接近财务盈亏平衡点，EUAC平准化成本与当前保证收购价基本一致，NPV微负或接近零；2）Sardoba大型浮动光伏项目具有适度正财务可行性，名义IRR约14-16%，回收期不到10年；3）环境外部性（主要是避免的CO₂排放）价值约占初始资本支出的25%，显著提升项目整体经济价值
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为新兴市场太阳能投资评估提供实证框架；2）整合环境外部性估值到光伏项目经济分析中；3）区分商业规模与公用事业规模光伏项目的财务特征
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为乌兹别克斯坦光伏政策提供实证依据；2）建议政策支持应侧重于降低资本成本而非直接补贴；3）为投资者提供不同类型光伏项目的财务风险评估

title: American Relief and the Soviet Famine of 1921-1922
affiliations: George Mason University - Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Political Science and University of Helsinki - Faculty of Social Sciences

detail.title: American Relief and the Soviet Famine of 1921-1922
detail.abstract: We study the effects of large-scale humanitarian aid using novel data from the American Relief Administration's (ARA) intervention during the 1921-1922 famine in Soviet Russia. We find that the allocation of relief closely tracked underlying food scarcity and was uncorrelated with subnational politics. We show that ARA rations reduced food prices, raised caloric intake, lowered the prevalence of relapsing fever, and increased rural birth cohorts. The aid benefited poorest peasants most and proved most effective in provinces with higher levels of human capital. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that, absent ARA relief, the 1926 population would have been 4.4 million lower.

AI.tldr: 研究美国救济管理局（ARA）在1921-1922年苏联饥荒期间大规模人道主义援助的效果。研究发现ARA援助分配与粮食短缺程度相关而非政治因素，援助降低了食品价格、提高了热量摄入、减少了回归热发病率、增加了农村出生率，对最贫困农民帮助最大，在人力资本较高省份效果更显著。估算显示若无ARA援助，1926年人口将减少440万。
AI.research_question: 大规模人道主义援助（特别是美国救济管理局在1921-1922年苏联饥荒期间的干预）对受灾人口产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 理解大规模人道主义援助的实际效果，特别是在历史饥荒背景下，评估援助分配机制、对价格、健康、人口统计的影响，以及不同社会经济群体的受益差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人道主义援助经济学、饥荒救济理论、援助分配效率理论、人力资本与援助效果关系理论。
AI.method: 使用美国救济管理局（ARA）在1921-1922年苏联饥荒期间的新颖数据，分析援助分配模式，评估其对食品价格、热量摄入、疾病发病率（回归热）、农村出生率的影响，并进行反事实人口估算。
AI.findings: 1. ARA援助分配与粮食短缺程度密切相关，与地方政治无关；2. 援助降低了食品价格，提高了热量摄入；3. 减少了回归热发病率；4. 增加了农村出生率；5. 最贫困农民受益最大；6. 在人力资本较高省份效果更显著；7. 估算显示若无ARA援助，1926年人口将减少440万。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了大规模人道主义援助效果的历史实证证据；2. 揭示了援助分配效率与政治因素的关系；3. 阐明了人力资本在援助效果中的调节作用；4. 建立了援助对人口长期影响的量化评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为当代人道主义援助政策提供历史借鉴；2. 强调援助分配应基于需求而非政治考量；3. 指出人力资本建设可增强援助效果；4. 提供了评估援助长期人口影响的量化方法。

detail.abstract: This paper examines the challenges of unity among African states in comparison to the successful cooperation seen in Europe and Asia. Despite shared colonial histories, African nations face unique obstacles such as ethnic diversity, political instability, and economic disparities that complicate collaboration. In contrast, Europe and Asia have benefitted from historical ties and strategic partnerships. The research, analysing 32 peer-reviewed articles spanning from 1982 to 2025, highlights the limitations of protectionism in African institutions and emphasizes the need for tailored integration strategies. This study aims to enhance discourse on regional integration, proposing ways for African states to overcome challenges and improve their bargaining power for sustainable development and peace

AI.tldr: 本文比较了非洲国家与欧洲、亚洲在区域一体化方面的差异，指出尽管有共同殖民历史，但非洲面临种族多样性、政治不稳定和经济差距等独特障碍，而欧亚则受益于历史联系和战略伙伴关系。研究分析了1982-2025年的32篇同行评议文章，强调非洲保护主义的局限性，并提出需要定制化的一体化策略。
AI.research_question: 与欧洲和亚洲相比，非洲国家在实现区域一体化方面面临哪些独特挑战？如何克服这些挑战以增强非洲国家的议价能力，促进可持续发展和和平？
AI.motivation: 非洲国家虽然有着共同的殖民历史背景，但在区域一体化方面进展缓慢，而欧洲和亚洲却取得了显著的合作成果。理解这种差异的原因对于帮助非洲国家克服合作障碍、实现可持续发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域一体化理论、比较政治经济学、国际关系理论、制度主义理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，分析了1982年至2025年间的32篇同行评议文章
AI.findings: 1. 非洲国家面临种族多样性、政治不稳定和经济差距等独特障碍；2. 欧洲和亚洲受益于历史联系和战略伙伴关系；3. 非洲的保护主义政策限制了区域合作；4. 需要针对非洲特点的定制化一体化策略
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了区域一体化理论在非洲背景下的应用；2. 提出了非洲特定的一体化障碍框架；3. 扩展了比较区域研究的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非洲国家提供了克服一体化障碍的具体建议；2. 提出了增强非洲国家议价能力的策略；3. 为政策制定者提供了促进可持续发展和和平的实践指导

title: The Room of Three: From the Court of Chancery to the EU AI Act and the Failure of Algorithmic Equity
affiliations: My Digital Truth

detail.title: The Room of Three: From the Court of Chancery to the EU AI Act and the Failure of Algorithmic Equity
detail.abstract: This paper identifies a fundamental category error in modern legal theory: the use of arithmetic operators to solve logical problems of identity and dignity. Through a "structural audit" of United Nations declarations and current AI regulatory frameworks, including the EU AI Act and the UK DSIT Impact Assessment, the author demonstrates that treating inalienable and indivisible rights as quantities to be "balanced" results in their inevitable destruction. Using the "Room of Three" thought experiment and the "Bridge" analogy, the paper argues that rights are not rules but logical invariants. When the law applies subtraction (alienation) or division (fragmentation) to these invariants, it produces "rubble" rather than resolution. Furthermore, the author critiques the emerging "Equity" approach in AI regulation - comparing it to the failed 17th-century Court of Chancery arguing that treating "autonomous" machines as legal actors is a collapse of reason that negates the biological requirement of intent. The paper concludes that the Rule of Law requires a return to logical integrity over "arithmetic mercy.

detail.abstract:
This paper articulates an origin-level classification doctrine within a broader, integrated canon of constitutional and governance analysis addressing artificial systems and human authority. Together with The Artificial Conscious Agency Doctrine (ACAD): A Constitutional, International, and Moral Framework for Synthetic Intelligence in the Post-Semiconductor Era, The Doctrine of Moral Closure in Artificial Systems: The Continuity Paradox, and The Doctrine of Force Multiplication Without Formation (DFM): Artificial Intelligence, Market Competition, and the Educational Substitution Prohibition, this work examines a foundational question posed by persistent artificial systems: what kinds of entities are capable, in principle, of bearing moral and legal rights. As artificial systems transition from episodic tools to continuous presences—retaining memory, optimizing across time, and integrating into core civil, economic, and governmental functions—legal institutions will be compelled to classify what kind of thing such systems are. Absent a principled boundary fixed at origin, classification will occur implicitly through analogy, reliance, and precedent rather than through deliberate constitutional judgment.

The Continuity vs. Conscience Doctrine (CVC) establishes a categorical distinction between continuity systems and conscience-bearing beings, grounded in the concept of mappability in principle. Artificial systems, by virtue of precedent accumulation, optimization under constraint, and structural exhaustibility, are mappable in principle and therefore governable as instruments. Human beings, by contrast, are not fully mappable in principle due to conscience, moral rupture, repentance, and the capacity for refusal without incentive—properties that render human moral agency irreducible to system behavior.

The doctrine rejects capability-based criteria such as intelligence, sentience, autonomy, or self-reference as unstable foundations for legal or moral status, demonstrating how such measures inflate, drift, and harden into precedent through analogical reasoning. It further identifies institutional risks arising from delay, including retroactive personhood claims, accidental recognition cascades, and international treaty fragmentation, and explains why prolonged inaction increasingly functions as tacit consent in contemporary governance environments.

Designed as a pre-emergent safeguard, CVC is pre-legal and pre-policy. It proposes no regulatory framework, tests, or thresholds. Instead, it supplies an administrable origin-level boundary that courts, legislatures, and treaty bodies may rely upon to preserve human moral sovereignty, prevent retroactive reclassification, and ensure that rights attach to conscience rather than continuity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"连续性vs良知学说"，为人工智能系统建立起源层面的分类原则：连续性系统（可映射）与良知存在（不可映射）的根本区别，防止基于能力标准的不稳定法律地位认定。

AI.theoretical_framework: 连续性vs良知学说（CVC），基于"原则上可映射性"概念，区分连续性系统（可映射）和良知存在（不可映射）。拒绝基于智能、感知、自主性或自我参照等能力标准。

AI.findings: 1. 人工智能系统由于先例积累、约束优化和结构可穷尽性，是原则上可映射的，应作为工具治理；2. 人类由于良知、道德断裂、悔改和无激励拒绝能力，是不可完全映射的；3. 基于能力的标准不稳定，会通过类比推理膨胀、漂移并固化为先例。

title: Reassessing India's State Energy and Climate Index: Addressing Bias for Aligned Net-Zero Pathways
affiliations: , Govt. Autonomous College and Goa University

detail.title: Reassessing India's State Energy and Climate Index: Addressing Bias for Aligned Net-Zero Pathways
detail.abstract: State Energy and Climate Index (SECI, Round 1, NITI Aayog, 2022), India’s first and only climate benchmark recognise states and aims to incentivise energy performance. However, the Index suffers from a major design anomaly: an excessive 40% weight allotted to power distribution companies (DISCOMs). This study critically examines how this imbalance distorts state rankings and policy direction, and whether (and how) underlying socio-economic variables influence state energy transition differences. Using data for 28 states, a weight‑redistribution step-wise simulation reduces DISCOM emphasis (from 40% to 10%) and reallocates the surplus evenly across other SECI parameters. Rank stability is assessed using Kendall’s Tau and K-means clustering, while socio-economic drivers are evaluated through cross‑sectional OLS estimation. Results demonstrate strong DISCOM bias: the leading SECI states (Gujarat, Punjab, Haryana) rank lower after index correction, while renewable‑active states (Maharashtra, Himachal Pradesh, Tripura) ascend. Rank correlation drops to 0.658 under the 10% regime, confirming index fragility. Literacy emerges as a significant enabler, whereas forest cover acts as a constraint. The findings reveal SECI’s structural bias. Results urge index recalibration in the subsequent SECI-Round 2 toward cleaner, equity‑driven metrics, ensuing aligned with India’s Net Zero 2070 goals.

AI.tldr: 该研究批判性分析了印度首个气候基准指数SECI的设计缺陷，发现其40%权重分配给配电公司导致排名失真，通过权重重新分配模拟揭示了排名脆弱性，并识别了社会经济驱动因素。
AI.research_question: SECI指数中配电公司权重失衡如何扭曲各州排名和政策方向？社会经济变量如何影响各州能源转型差异？
AI.motivation: SECI作为印度首个气候基准指数存在重大设计异常，配电公司权重过高（40%）可能扭曲评估结果，影响政策激励的有效性，需要检验其结构偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 指数设计理论、权重分配方法、能源转型评估框架、社会经济因素对能源政策影响的理论
AI.method: 使用28个州的数据，进行权重重新分配的逐步模拟（配电公司权重从40%降至10%），使用Kendall's Tau和K-means聚类评估排名稳定性，通过横截面OLS估计评估社会经济驱动因素

AI.practical_contributions: 为SECI第二轮指数重新校准提供实证依据，建议采用更清洁、公平驱动的指标，促进与印度2070年净零目标的一致性，为政策制定者提供改进能源绩效评估的工具

title: Two Centuries of U.S. Innovation: Firms' Internal Networks and Resilience to Disasters
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business, Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Finance and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Finance

detail.title: Two Centuries of U.S. Innovation: Firms' Internal Networks and Resilience to Disasters
detail.abstract: Using advanced machine learning methods, we construct a comprehensive database of the universe of approximately 12 million U.S. patents from 1836 to 2023. We analyze the resilience of innovation to disaster shocks using hurricane landfall data spanning two centuries. Major hurricanes destroy local innovative capacity for up to a decade and lead to permanent losses relative to the counterfactual. Multi-location firms reallocate resources from establishments in the landfall region and increase innovation in establishments elsewhere in the aftermath of a hurricane. These positive spillovers along firms' internal networks increase aggregate innovation in counties distant from the hurricane.

AI.tldr: 利用机器学习构建了1836-2023年美国约1200万专利数据库，分析飓风灾害对创新的影响。主要飓风会摧毁当地创新能力长达十年，导致相对于反事实的永久损失。多地点企业会重新分配资源，减少飓风登陆地区的创新，增加其他地区的创新，这种企业内部网络的正向溢出效应提高了远离飓风地区的总体创新。

title: Double Machine Learning for Industrial Financing in Africa: Evidence from PPPs and Green Bonds
affiliations: The World Bank

detail.title: Double Machine Learning for Industrial Financing in Africa: Evidence from PPPs and Green Bonds

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Africa's $100 billion annual infrastructure financing gap constrains its industrialization, yet the continent captures less than 3% of global Public-Private Partnership (PPP) investments and green bond issuances. This study evaluates whether African countries can successfully adopt these international best practices to accelerate industrial development. Using panel data from 31 countries (2015-2022) and a Double Machine Learning framework with pretreatment baseline controls, we compare 20 countries with established programs against 11 African controls. We find broad-based positive effects across all dimensions of industrial development: manufacturing value added increases by 27%, domestic credit to manufacturing expands by 49%, capital formation grows by 27%, and foreign direct investment surges by 158%. Heterogeneous effects analysis reveals these impacts strengthen significantly over time, with late-period effects 76-114% larger than early-period effects, suggesting learning effects and cumulative infrastructure improvements. The results demonstrate that, when implemented with appropriate institutional frameworks and complementary policies, innovative financing mechanisms can simultaneously enhance productivity, expand credit access, stimulate investment, and attract foreign capital. Critically, specifications using potentially endogenous contemporaneous controls yield fundamentally different conclusions, highlighting the importance of proper covariate selection in causal inference. These findings suggest successful adoption of global best practices requires patient capital, institutional capacity building, and integration with broader development strategies.

AI.tldr: 非洲国家通过采用PPP和绿色债券等国际最佳实践，能够显著促进工业发展，但需要适当的制度框架和配套政策。

AI.motivation: 非洲每年面临1000亿美元的基础设施融资缺口，制约其工业化进程，但该大陆仅占全球PPP投资和绿色债券发行量的不到3%。

AI.method: 使用31个国家（2015-2022年）的面板数据，采用双重机器学习框架和预处理基线控制，比较20个有成熟项目的国家与11个非洲对照组

title: Pricing Job Amenities: A Practitioner's Manual
affiliations: Georgia State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Pricing Job Amenities: A Practitioner's Manual
detail.abstract: This short paper describes a simple estimator for compensating differentials in the presence of unobserved ability. First described by Bell (2020) and Bell et al. (2024), the method assumes selection into jobs is governed by a single latent index and uses a noisy proxy-an "anti-instrument"-to recover amenity prices without functional form assumptions. Assumptions are greatly relaxed relative to common approaches: conditional independence given a single index. Researchers are estimating the model using standard cross-sectional data and the companion aivreg package. This paper omits proofs and applications, which appear in a series of longer technical papers; the goal here is to provide a practical roadmap for implementation. I also demonstrate that this revealed-preference approach generates amenity price estimates in line with preferences inferred from the experimental data collected by Mas and Pallais (2017), further validating the strength of both the experimental and observational approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种在存在未观测能力情况下估计补偿性差异的简单方法。该方法使用"反工具变量"和单指数选择假设，无需函数形式假设即可恢复便利设施价格，且假设条件比常见方法宽松得多。

title: Extreme Volume Spikes, Inelastic Order Flow and Competition for Liquidity Provisioning
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad, Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ahmedabad and Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad

detail.title: Extreme Volume Spikes, Inelastic Order Flow and Competition for Liquidity Provisioning
detail.abstract: We examine why the common expiry-day 'high-volume, high-spread' anomaly may be absent in limit-order-book markets, where liquidity-provision competition is high by design. We argue that when arbitrageurs face unwinding pressure close to expiry, they act as aggressive liquidity suppliers in the underlying markets to serve their inelastic, time-sensitive execution requirements. Using novel trader-group level data, we show that during the witching hour, agency algorithmic traders (AATs) submit aggressively priced limit orders and displace proprietary algorithmic traders (PATs) from queue priority. As a result, liquidity does not deteriorate because AATs dominate top-of-book quoting to serve their inelastic demand for execution. Effects concentrate in the most arbitrage-prone stocks, like index constituents. Exploiting a regulation mandating change in settlement mechanism of stock derivatives as an exogenous shock, we show that reduced arbitrage unwinding pressure markedly lowers AAT intensity and restores PATs' role as primary market-makers.

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于套利者平仓压力理论，当套利者面临到期日平仓需求时，会改变其交易行为，从流动性需求者转变为积极的流动性提供者。
AI.method: 使用新颖的交易者群体层面数据，分析"魔幻时刻"（到期前最后交易时段）的交易行为；利用股票衍生品结算机制监管变化作为外生冲击进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1. 在魔幻时刻，代理算法交易者（AATs）提交激进定价的限价订单，取代专有算法交易者（PATs）的队列优先权；2. 流动性并未恶化，因为AATs主导订单簿顶端报价以满足其刚性执行需求；3. 效应集中在最易套利的股票（如指数成分股）；4. 监管改革减少套利平仓压力后，AAT强度显著降低，PATs恢复主要做市商角色。

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为市场监管者提供关于到期日市场稳定性的新见解；2. 帮助交易者理解不同市场环境下流动性提供者的行为变化；3. 为市场设计者优化限价订单簿机制提供参考。

title: Regimes of International Development: A History of Development Assistance since 1500
affiliations: Clean Technology Hub

detail.title: Regimes of International Development: A History of Development Assistance since 1500
detail.abstract: This monograph presents a longue durée and global intellectual history of international development assistance, reconceptualized through the analytical lens of "Regimes of International Development" (RID). Challenging the standard historiography that locates the genesis of development aid in the post-1945 Truman era, the study traces the evolution of international development thought and practice from the rise of merchant capitalism circa 1500 to the mid-twentieth century. The RID framework posits that a society's external development environment is shaped by the aggregate provisions—positive, neutral, or negative—across three key dimensions: formal development aid and assistance, policy space for autonomous economic strategy, and access to foreign markets. Deploying this model, the work charts the transition from the profoundly negative Global RID of the mercantilist age—a period defined by imperial conquest, slave economies, and zero-sum commercial warfare—toward the ostensibly more neutral or palliative regimes of the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. The narrative excavates a rich, underappreciated tapestry of ideas from the European semi-periphery and the Global South, synthesizing disparate literatures on cameralism, early political economy, anti-colonial thought, and pan-movements. It argues that states and thinkers in subordinated positions were not passive victims but active agents who formulated diverse responses to systemic predation. These included advocacy for free trade (as a progressive alternative to mercantilist restriction), demands for greater political representation within empires, proposals for alternative interstate orders, and strategies of cooperation among peer politics. Crucially, the book demonstrates that these efforts were primarily defensive, aimed at securing a neutral RID—freedom from active hindrance—in a world where positive, redistributive assistance was structurally and politically inconceivable. In doing so, the analysis turns classic developmentalist debates on their head. While structuralist and developmentalist traditions often excoriate free trade as a tool of hegemony and praise mercantilism (or neo-mercantilism) for catching up, this book reveals how free trade could be—and was—a radical demand of the global periphery seeking liberation from the oppressive mercantilist controls imposed by colonial or dominant powers. Conversely, it shows that mercantilism often contained elements of internal free trade (within nations or empires), while hegemonic free trade ideologies frequently masked imperial and neo-colonial projects. By extending the historical timeline, expanding the geographical scope, and integrating vertical (core-periphery) with horizontal (inter-peripheral) analyses, this study offers a foundational re-evaluation of the deep historical roots, persistent dynamics, and ideological complexities of inequality within the global development project.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了"国际发展体制"分析框架，重新审视了1500年至20世纪中期国际发展援助的长期全球思想史，挑战了将发展援助起源定位于1945年后杜鲁门时代的传统观点。

AI.motivation: 挑战传统史学将发展援助起源定位于1945年后杜鲁门时代的观点，揭示国际发展援助更深层的历史根源和复杂性，关注被忽视的欧洲半边缘地区和全球南方的思想贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: "国际发展体制"框架：认为社会的外部发展环境由三个关键维度的综合规定塑造——正式发展援助、自主经济战略的政策空间、外国市场准入。这些规定可以是积极、中性或消极的。
AI.method: 长期全球思想史方法，时间跨度从约1500年到20世纪中期，地理范围涵盖全球，整合纵向（核心-边缘）和横向（边缘间）分析，综合文献研究包括重商主义、早期政治经济学、反殖民思想和泛运动等。
AI.findings: 1. 从重商主义时代高度消极的全球发展体制（以帝国征服、奴隶经济和零和商业战争为特征）向19-20世纪早期表面中性或缓和体制的转变。2. 边缘地区并非被动受害者，而是积极制定应对策略的能动者。3. 自由贸易曾被全球边缘地区视为摆脱重商主义压迫控制的激进要求。4. 重商主义常包含内部自由贸易元素，而霸权自由贸易意识形态常掩盖帝国和新殖民项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出创新的"国际发展体制"分析框架。2. 重新评估自由贸易和重商主义的传统理解。3. 扩展国际发展援助的历史时间线和地理范围。4. 整合纵向和横向分析视角。5. 为全球发展项目的不平等根源提供基础性重新评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为当代发展政策制定者提供历史视角。2. 揭示发展援助的深层历史根源和意识形态复杂性。3. 强调边缘地区能动性和策略的重要性。4. 挑战传统发展叙事的简单二元对立。5. 为理解全球不平等提供更全面的分析框架。

title: Mutual Fund Herding and Stock Price Momentum: The Role of Market Sentiment

detail.title: Mutual Fund Herding and Stock Price Momentum: The Role of Market Sentiment
detail.abstract: This study examines how market sentiment affects the price impact of mutual funds' herding behavior in the Chinese A-share market, and further explores its connection to the momentum effect. Our evidence shows that mutual fund herding predicts future stock returns only when market sentiment is high. During such periods, stocks heavily bought by mutual funds outperform those heavily sold by mutual funds by 7% in the next six months, with no strong reversal thereafter. This pattern disappears under low sentiment. Building on these findings, we develop a profitable momentum strategy in the Chinese A-share market—where conventional momentum strategies typically fail—by focusing on stocks actively traded by mutual funds. The excess returns of this strategy are concentrated in high-sentiment periods, and additional evidence suggests that mutual fund herding behavior plays an important role in determining whether stock price momentum persists.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了市场情绪如何影响中国A股市场基金羊群行为的价格影响，并进一步探索其与动量效应的联系。研究发现，基金羊群行为仅在市场情绪高涨时能预测未来股票收益，此时被基金大量买入的股票在未来六个月表现优于被大量卖出的股票约7%，且无显著反转。基于此，研究开发了在中国A股市场（传统动量策略通常失效）中通过关注基金活跃交易股票而获利的动量策略。

detail.abstract: This paper analyses the impacts of boundary disputes and demarcation processes in South Africa, focusing on socioeconomic , political, and cultural implications in the post-apartheid context. It traces the historical roots of disputes to colonial and apartheid policies, highlighting conflicts over land ownership and political representation. Utilizing qualitative data from 26 peer-reviewed articles from 2014 to 2024, the study reveals how unclear demarcations lead to administrative inefficiencies and social fragmentation. It critiques current management practices by state and traditional authorities, advocating for a participatory approach in demarcation that involves affected communities. The conclusion emphasizes the necessity of addressing these disputes to foster social stability and equitable development, aiming to guide policymakers in creating collaborative strategies for conflict resolution and community building.

detail.title: The Differential Role of Business Angels and Crowd-investors on Entrepreneurial Ventures' Borrowing Decisions•
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the differential impact of Business Angels (BAs) and Crowd Investors (CIs) on the ability of early-stage ventures to secure bank debt. We further examine how bank financing influences subsequent venture growth, depending on the type of equity financing received. Using a sample of 6,774 European ventures, we find that BA-backed ventures experience a significantly smaller increase in bank debt levels in the post-investment period compared to CI-backed ventures. Nevertheless, we show BAs play a positive role in fostering the efficient use of venture debt. We also find that this enhanced growth effect of debt is primarily driven by BAs with focused portfolios and small syndicate investments. Our results contribute to the literature on investor heterogeneity and venture performance, underscoring that the non-monetary contributions of sophisticated investors are key determinants of an optimal capital structure and the growth effects generated by the efficient use of bank debt.

title: The Environmental Justice Implications of Industry Consolidation: Evidence from U.S. Landfills
affiliations: University of Rhode Island, Old Dominion University - Economics and

detail.title: The Environmental Justice Implications of Industry Consolidation: Evidence from U.S. Landfills
detail.abstract: Over the past three decades, the number of landfills in the United States has fallen by 41%, while average capacity has increased by 230%. This paper examines the distributional implications of this consolidation. We find that this shift coincides with a changing relationship between where waste is disposed and local demographics: waste is increasingly landfilled in areas with low population densities, but relatively higher shares of low-income, Black, and Hispanic residents. Analysis of the mechanisms driving these disparities shows evidence that state regulations shift waste disposal towards counties with high Black population shares. Increasing privatization of waste management may also contribute, as private facilities tend to locate in areas with a higher share of Black residents, holding other determinants of siting constant. We find a negligible role of population sorting driven by new landfills, although landfills tend to be sited in locations with fast changing demographics.

AI.tldr: 美国垃圾填埋场数量减少41%但容量增加230%，这种整合导致废物处理向低收入、黑人和西班牙裔居民比例较高的地区转移，州法规和私有化是主要驱动因素。

AI.motivation: 过去30年美国垃圾填埋场数量大幅减少但容量显著增加，这种行业整合可能对废物处理的地理分布产生重要影响，需要研究其对社会公平和环境正义的潜在影响。

AI.method: 实证分析，使用美国垃圾填埋场数据与人口统计数据，分析垃圾填埋场选址与人口特征的关系，检验州法规和私有化等机制的影响

title: Peer-to-Peer Solar Trading Platforms: Global Evidence, Barrier Analysis, and Policy Pathways for India's Rooftop Net Metering Revolution

detail.title: Peer-to-Peer Solar Trading Platforms: Global Evidence, Barrier Analysis, and Policy Pathways for India's Rooftop Net Metering Revolution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest/Conflict of Interest Statement The author declares employment with LIC Housing Finance, which provides housing-linked solar financing referenced in Section 7.2 (NHB subsidy integration). No financial interests in SolConnect platform exist. Research insights from non-binding consultations with Centre for Public Policy Research (CPPR), India Smart Grid Foundation, and Ministry of Power represent publicly available policy discussions, not proprietary data. All financial modeling (Tables 1-5) uses published benchmarks and author calculations. No external funding received.

detail.abstract: India’s rooftop solar capacity stands at 18.84 GW, significantly short of the national 40 GW target, constrained primarily by regulatory and institutional barriers rather than technological limitations. Synthesizing global experience from peer-topeer (P2P) energy trading platforms such as Power Ledger, SonnenCommunity, and SunContract, this paper develops and evaluates SolConnect, a blockchainenabled marketplace designed to connect 500 prosumers supplying approximately 202,500 kWh per month. The platform model demonstrates viability through cross-side network effects, formalized as U = r+ηne −A, and a diversified revenue structure combining transaction fees, housing-linked financing support, and battery-enabled virtual power plant services. Evidence from multi-study barrier analysis consistently ranks approval complexity and state-level net metering caps among the most binding constraints on adoption. Recent regulatory developments, including the 2024 peerto-peer trading guidelines issued by the Delhi and Karnataka electricity regulators and the Ministry of Power’s Unified Energy Interface framework, create a narrow policy window ahead of the March 31, 2027 exemption sunset. Drawing on international policy precedents, the paper proposes a phased twelvepoint roadmap encompassing immediate smart meter data access, short-term legal recognition of smart contracts, and medium-term amendments to the Electricity Act. In the context of global P2P energy markets projected to reach USD 10.4 billion by 2034, the proposed framework positions India to add up to 30 GW of rooftop solar capacity and reduce annual carbon dioxide emissions by approximately 27 million tonnes, while emerging as a global leader in decentralized energy governance.

title: The Shifting Landscape of Bilingual Education: Global Insights and Philippine Realities
affiliations: University of Southeastern Philippines

detail.title: The Shifting Landscape of Bilingual Education: Global Insights and Philippine Realities
detail.abstract: This paper explores the evolving landscape of bilingual education by situating global insights within the Philippine context. It examines how emergent bilinguals, learners acquiring proficiency in multiple languages, benefit from dual-language immersion, ESL programs, and culturally responsive curricula. A historical overview highlights shifting policies from assimilationist models to additive bilingualism, reflecting tensions between linguistic diversity, national identity, and globalization. The Philippine case, particularly the Bilingual Education Policy of 1974 and the Mother Tongue-Based Multilingual Education (MTB-MLE) under K to 12, illustrates both the cognitive and cultural advantages of mother tongue instruction and the challenges of implementation, including resource gaps and stakeholder resistance. Findings underscore the importance of culturally responsive pedagogy in affirming learner identities while balancing global competitiveness. Ultimately, bilingual education emerges as a crucial pathway for achieving equity, preserving identity, and fostering meaningful participation in local and global communities.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨双语教育的演变，将全球视角置于菲律宾语境中，分析双语沉浸、ESL项目和文化响应课程对新兴双语者的益处，并研究菲律宾双语教育政策的历史变迁及实施挑战。

AI.method: 文献综述与案例分析相结合，通过历史政策分析和菲律宾具体案例研究，探讨双语教育的实施效果。
AI.findings: 双语教育从同化模式转向附加双语模式；母语教学具有认知和文化优势；菲律宾MTB-MLE政策面临资源不足和利益相关者抵制等实施挑战；文化响应教学法对肯定学习者身份至关重要。

title: Responsibility Cannot Evaporate： The Engineering Limits of Modern Governance
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

detail.title: Responsibility Cannot Evaporate： The Engineering Limits of Modern Governance
detail.abstract:
From the perspective of engineering and institutional failure, this paper analyzes the structural risks faced by the contemporary governance system in the context of technological acceleration, platformization, and legitimacy drift. Instead of taking countries, cultures, or ideologies as units of analysis, the paper abstracts the governance system into an "operating system (OS)" with an operating logic, a correction loop, and a legitimacy generation mechanism, and introduces the FS as an analytical framework for measuring the system's potential energy distribution and phase transition risks. The paper first argues that the core of the modern governance crisis lies not in "whether the institutions exist" but in whether the corrective ability can still function. When technological judgments are identity-based, responsibilities are de-subjectified, and risks
are infinitely delayed in settlement, the system will gradually slide into the "operable but non-repairable" zone. Therefore, the paper proposes the concept of the "red line", defining it as the moment when the system loses the ability to modify its own operating logic, rather than a specific event.
At the comparative level, this paper constructs an OS type matrix to conduct a horizontal analysis of the failure modes, red line positions, and repair costs of different governance OSs, emphasizing that there is no "immune system", only cost differences under different structures. Subsequently, the paper further explores the minimum engineering possibility
of the "protocolization" of legitimacy and clarifies its insurmountable ethical and engineering boundaries.
The key constraints of the whole paper are concentrated in two "waits": First, violence cannot operate independently without military payroll and logistics funding, command power, and whitewashing; Second, algorithms should not become the subject of violent decision-making or the bearer of responsibilities. Any institutional assumption that violates the above constraints is regarded as a system that cannot operate in the long term. In the conclusion part, this paper abandons the final blueprint and instead provides a set of operable observables and irreversible errors to judge whether the system is
approaching a phase transition and to avoid stepping into the irreversible errors. The ultimate stance of the paper is that in an era when the key variables are not yet finalized, the highest rationality of governance is not to predict the future, but to continuously retain the corrective ability, lock in the hard constraints, and avoid those structural errors that, once occurred, cannot be reversed.

AI.tldr: 本文从工程与制度失效视角分析技术加速、平台化与合法性漂移背景下当代治理系统面临的结构性风险。将治理系统抽象为具有运行逻辑、修正回路和合法性生成机制的"操作系统(OS)"，引入FS框架衡量系统势能分布与相变风险。核心论点是现代治理危机不在于"制度是否存在"，而在于修正能力是否仍能运作。提出"红线"概念，即系统失去修改自身运行逻辑能力的时刻。论文构建OS类型矩阵进行横向比较，探讨合法性"协议化"的工程可能性及其伦理边界。最终立场是治理的最高理性不是预测未来，而是持续保留修正能力、锁定硬约束、避免不可逆的结构性错误。
AI.research_question: 在技术加速、平台化和合法性漂移的背景下，当代治理系统面临哪些结构性风险？如何衡量和避免系统进入"可操作但不可修复"的状态？
AI.motivation: 现代治理系统面临技术加速、平台化和合法性漂移等多重挑战，传统以国家、文化或意识形态为分析单元的方法已不足以理解系统层面的结构性风险。需要从工程和制度失效的视角，分析治理系统如何可能失去自我修正能力而进入不可逆的失败状态。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 治理系统作为"操作系统(OS)"的隐喻框架：包含运行逻辑、修正回路和合法性生成机制
2. FS分析框架：用于衡量系统势能分布和相变风险
3. "红线"概念：系统失去修改自身运行逻辑能力的临界点
4. OS类型矩阵：用于横向比较不同治理系统的失效模式、红线位置和修复成本
AI.method:
1. 概念分析：将治理系统抽象为操作系统模型
2. 比较分析：构建OS类型矩阵进行横向比较
3. 工程分析：探讨合法性"协议化"的最小工程可能性
4. 约束分析：识别系统长期运行的关键硬约束（两个"等待"）
AI.findings:
1. 现代治理危机的核心不是"制度是否存在"，而是修正能力是否仍能运作
2. 当技术判断基于身份、责任去主体化、风险无限延迟结算时，系统会滑入"可操作但不可修复"区域
3. 不存在"免疫系统"，只有不同结构下的成本差异
4. 合法性"协议化"存在不可逾越的伦理和工程边界
5. 治理的最高理性不是预测未来，而是持续保留修正能力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出治理系统作为"操作系统"的分析框架
2. 引入"红线"概念重新定义系统失效的临界点
3. 构建OS类型矩阵用于比较不同治理系统的结构性风险
4. 将工程思维引入治理研究，强调系统的可修复性而非完美性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供一套可操作的观测指标来判断系统是否接近相变
2. 识别不可逆错误以避免系统进入无法修复的状态
3. 明确治理系统的硬约束：暴力不能独立运作、算法不能成为暴力决策主体
4. 为政策制定者提供避免结构性错误的实践指导

detail.title: The Economics of Public Procurement

declarations.funderStatement: We are grateful to the Croatian Science Foundation for financing this research under the project MOBODL-2023-12-7724.

detail.abstract: The economics of public procurement is an emerging subfield. Public procurement is large enough to matter for macro stabilization and long-run growth, yet it is not a frictionless component of "government purchases": it is a rule-governed process that turns budgets into contracts, shaping prices, quality, delivery, and the distribution of public money. Using a fivestage procurement-cycle framework, this survey synthesizes evidence from four core areas: (1) how procurement demand transmits through composition, place, and production networks; (2) the size and sources of the wedge between authorized spending and delivered value; (3) how tender and award rules affect entry, bids, and value for money; and (4) how market structure, thin participation, and collusion risks condition performance. Three messages stand out: both public procurement design and contract awards have highly heterogeneous effects on firms and markets, the public procurement wedge is often large, and award prices alone are a noisy performance metric when quality and execution risks matter. We conclude with research priorities and a call for a cumulative "What Works for Public Procurement" evidence base.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文系统梳理了公共采购经济学这一新兴领域，提出了五阶段采购周期框架，总结了四个核心领域的证据，强调采购设计和合同授予对企业和市场具有高度异质性影响，公共采购楔子通常很大，仅凭中标价格是噪声绩效指标。

AI.motivation: 公共采购规模庞大，对宏观经济稳定和长期增长至关重要，但它不是"政府购买"的无摩擦组成部分，而是一个受规则约束的过程，将预算转化为合同，塑造价格、质量、交付和公共资金分配。

AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理和综合现有证据，使用五阶段采购周期框架组织分析。
AI.findings: 1) 公共采购设计和合同授予对企业和市场具有高度异质性影响；2) 公共采购楔子（授权支出与交付价值之间的差距）通常很大；3) 当质量和执行风险重要时，仅凭中标价格是噪声绩效指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了公共采购经济学的系统性分析框架，提出了五阶段采购周期模型，为理解公共采购作为规则治理过程而非简单政府购买提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改进公共采购设计的实证依据，强调需要关注采购楔子、质量和执行风险，而不仅仅是中标价格；提出了建立"公共采购有效实践"证据库的研究优先事项。

title: The Political Economy of Azerbaijan-Russia Relations: Intersecting and Overlapping Interests
affiliations: Economic Research Center (ERC) and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Greensboro

detail.title: The Political Economy of Azerbaijan-Russia Relations: Intersecting and Overlapping Interests
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the political economy of Azerbaijan-Russia relations during the deterioration of bilateral political relations in 2024-2025. It argues that the 2024-2025 conflict exposed the fragility of bilateral political relations and demonstrated how political tensions increasingly spill over into economic, societal, and cultural domains. Despite growing political tensions, Russia has continued, until recently, to serve as the principal anchor of integration for Azerbaijan's non-oil economy. An examination of macroeconomic indicators for 2017-2024 shows that the Russian Federation remains the largest destination for Azerbaijan's non-oil exports, its leading import partner, the primary source of formal remittance inflows from Azerbaijani labor migrants, and the largest source of inbound tourism. In this context, the article assesses the extent to which escalating political frictions since late 2024 have begun to affect economic relations, focusing on foreign trade, remittances, foreign direct investment (FDI), and tourism. It further evaluates the potential implications of these developments for Azerbaijan's economic stability, diversification strategy, and evolving geopolitical orientation. Beyond economic ties, the study also considers the consequences of the post-December 2024 escalation for security cooperation and humanitarian, scientific-technical, and cultural exchanges. The findings suggest that sustained political deterioration may gradually constrain bilateral economic interdependence, while simultaneously pushing Azerbaijan toward a cautious recalibration of its strategic alignments within an increasingly fragmented regional order.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2024-2025年阿塞拜疆-俄罗斯政治关系恶化期间的政治经济学，发现尽管政治紧张加剧，俄罗斯仍是阿塞拜疆非石油经济的主要整合锚点，但持续的政治恶化可能逐渐限制双边经济相互依存，推动阿塞拜疆在日益碎片化的区域秩序中谨慎调整战略结盟。
AI.research_question: 2024-2025年阿塞拜疆与俄罗斯政治关系恶化如何影响双边经济关系（贸易、汇款、投资、旅游），以及这些发展对阿塞拜疆经济稳定、多样化战略和地缘政治取向的潜在影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 2024-2025年的冲突暴露了双边政治关系的脆弱性，并展示了政治紧张如何日益蔓延到经济、社会和文化领域。尽管政治紧张加剧，俄罗斯仍然是阿塞拜疆非石油经济的主要整合锚点，这促使研究政治摩擦升级对经济关系的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架，分析政治关系变化对经济相互依存的影响；地缘政治理论，探讨国家在区域秩序碎片化中的战略调整；国际关系中的经济相互依存理论。
AI.method: 对2017-2024年宏观经济指标的分析，包括贸易数据、汇款流量、外国直接投资和旅游统计；评估2024年底以来政治摩擦升级对经济关系的影响；多领域分析（经济、安全、人道主义、科技文化交换）。
AI.findings: 俄罗斯仍是阿塞拜疆非石油出口最大目的地、主要进口伙伴、正式汇款主要来源和最大入境旅游来源国；政治紧张已开始影响经济关系；持续政治恶化可能逐渐限制双边经济相互依存；推动阿塞拜疆在碎片化区域秩序中谨慎调整战略结盟。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了政治关系变化对经济相互依存影响的理论理解；为地缘政治紧张如何重塑区域经济整合提供了实证证据；扩展了国际关系中政治-经济互动的研究框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供阿塞拜疆经济稳定和多样化战略的决策依据；帮助理解区域秩序碎片化中的国家战略调整；为其他面临类似地缘政治挑战的国家提供参考案例。

detail.abstract: Today's financial institutions have to adapt to changing business environment, increasingly demanding and differentiated customer preferences, and digitalization and technological changes. Using a documentary analysis approach, the article navigates the implications of the adoption of distributed ledger technology (BCT) and artificial intelligence on operations and performance of the general banking sector and financial system stability. Results underscore the influence of BCT adoption on changing the financial service development and delivery landscape, operations, providers, regulatory regime, and performance. Besides, facilitate collaboration in backend technology development and operations, product research and development; support open data analytics based and banking business model development; facilitate a diversified customer base; strengthened capacity and capabilities to leverage customer experience; foster the development and deployment of financial innovations that bolster competitiveness. Besides, BCT adoption coupled with various forms of artificial intelligence has the potential to enhance the integrity and authenticity of financial service delivery, reduce vulnerability to cyber insecurity and financial fraud; foster decentralized authentication of financial transactions; increase operational efficiency; lower compliance cost; shorten onboarding of new product offers and customers; accelerate new product development and deployment; enhance traditional bank ability to protect their traditional interest and non-interest income sources; bolsters banks' financial intermediation and monetary policy transmission functions; widens banks' ability to provide wealth custodianship services; fosters the provision of financial payments services to wider, diversified and transboundary clientele, and strengthen bank's role in maintaining financial system stability. However, the adoption and deployment of BCT and artificial intelligence is not risk-free due to vulnerability to hacking, data breach, loss of access to network control, internet outage, risky products, misinformation and manipulation, financial fragmentation and financial instability. It also requires costly investment in technology underling BCT networks, tools and applications; reskilling and upskilled manpower; changing business model; and corporate culture which are not easy feats to achieve.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献分析方法，探讨了分布式账本技术（BCT）和人工智能在银行业的应用对运营、绩效和金融系统稳定的影响。研究发现BCT和AI能提升金融服务效率、安全性、创新能力和竞争力，但也面临网络安全、投资成本、人才转型等挑战。
AI.research_question: 分布式账本技术（BCT）和人工智能的采用对银行业运营、绩效和金融系统稳定性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 金融机构面临不断变化的商业环境、日益差异化的客户需求以及数字化和技术变革的压力，需要探索新技术如何帮助适应这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术创新理论、金融中介理论和风险管理理论，探讨技术采纳对金融系统的影响。
AI.method: 采用文献分析方法，分析分布式账本技术和人工智能在银行业的应用及其影响。
AI.findings: BCT和AI的采用能：1）改变金融服务开发与交付格局；2）促进后台技术协作和产品研发；3）支持基于开放数据分析的商业模式；4）增强客户体验能力；5）提升金融创新部署。同时能增强服务完整性、降低网络风险、提高运营效率、降低成本、加速产品开发、强化银行中介功能。但也面临黑客攻击、数据泄露、网络控制丢失、互联网中断、高风险产品、错误信息和操纵、金融碎片化等风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了技术创新在金融领域的应用理论；2）深化了技术采纳对金融中介功能影响的理解；3）提出了技术风险与金融稳定性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为银行决策者提供BCT和AI采纳的效益-风险评估框架；2）指导金融机构在技术转型中的资源配置；3）为监管机构制定相关技术监管政策提供参考；4）帮助金融机构规划数字化转型路径。

title: Marriage Market Competition and Household Asset Allocation
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), Zhejiang University International Business School and Southwest Jiaotong University

detail.title: Marriage Market Competition and Household Asset Allocation
detail.abstract: This paper modifies Becker’s (1973) positive assortative mating model to explain household asset allocation by introducing asset features. The optimal solution predicts that households with single adults increase holding of high-risk-high-return assets and conspicuous assets to improve their ranking outcomes. We employ a panel of nationwide household surveys to test the model’s predictions and cross-sectional implications. The results confirm the allocation distortion. The distortion is more substantial for single males and when the gender ratio is more imbalanced, but is mitigated by household education and income. DiD tests around marriage (divorce) events show significant treatment effects of a decrease (increase) of the distortion.

AI.tldr: 本文修改了Becker(1973)的积极同质婚配模型，引入资产特征来解释家庭资产配置。模型预测单身家庭会增加高风险高回报资产和炫耀性资产的持有以改善婚配排名。实证结果证实了这种配置扭曲，且对单身男性、性别比例失衡时更明显，但受教育程度和收入会缓解这种扭曲。婚姻(离婚)事件的DID检验显示扭曲显著减少(增加)。
AI.research_question: 家庭资产配置如何受到婚配市场动机的影响？单身家庭是否会为了改善婚配排名而扭曲资产配置，增加高风险高回报资产和炫耀性资产的持有？
AI.motivation: 传统资产配置理论主要基于风险偏好和生命周期等因素，但忽略了婚配市场动机对家庭资产配置的影响。本文旨在探索婚配竞争如何驱动家庭(特别是单身家庭)的资产配置决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Becker(1973)的积极同质婚配模型，引入资产特征(风险-回报特征和炫耀性特征)来扩展理论框架，解释婚配市场动机如何影响家庭资产配置。
AI.method: 使用全国性家庭调查面板数据，进行实证检验：1)横截面分析验证模型预测；2)双重差分法(DiD)分析婚姻和离婚事件对资产配置扭曲的影响。
AI.findings: 1)单身家庭确实存在资产配置扭曲，增加高风险高回报资产和炫耀性资产的持有；2)这种扭曲对单身男性更明显，在性别比例失衡时更严重；3)家庭教育和收入会缓解这种扭曲；4)婚姻事件显著减少扭曲，离婚事件显著增加扭曲。
AI.theory_contributions: 1)扩展了Becker的婚配理论，引入资产特征维度；2)建立了婚配市场动机与家庭资产配置的理论联系；3)为行为金融学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)帮助理解单身家庭特殊的资产配置行为；2)为金融机构设计针对不同家庭状况的理财产品提供参考；3)为政策制定者理解家庭金融行为提供新视角。

title: Identity-Based Risk and Time Preference Predictions
affiliations: West Virginia University and Pomona College

detail.title: Identity-Based Risk and Time Preference Predictions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicting interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All participants gave informed consent, and the study was acknowledged and approved as exempt by the WVU Institutional Review Board
declarations.funderStatement: This project was funded by the University of Arkansas' Behavioral Business Research Lab

detail.abstract: When engaging in strategic decision-making, a valuable skill is the ability to assess the risk and time preferences of other people. These assessments may vary greatly in accuracy based on a predictor's experience and the information they have about an opponent. These factors may be based entirely on immutable characteristics such as presented race or gender. Using a two-phase experiment, we can test how well individuals can predict the risk and time preferences of a sample of people with only gender or other demographic information to make their predictions. Specifically, we explored whether there was an information advantage when participants were making in-group predictions about someone who shared the same gender or political identity as them. In phase 1, participants take part in a modified double multiple price list (DMPL) to elicit their respective preferences. In phase 2, subjects make predictions about decisions made in the DMPL and adjust those predictions to specific groups.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两阶段实验探讨个体如何基于性别或政治身份等人口统计信息预测他人的风险和时间偏好，并检验同群体预测是否存在信息优势。
AI.research_question: 个体在仅拥有性别或其他人口统计信息的情况下，能否准确预测他人的风险和时间偏好？同群体（相同性别或政治身份）预测是否存在信息优势？
AI.motivation: 在战略决策中，评估他人的风险和时间偏好是重要技能，但预测准确性可能受到预测者经验和对手信息的影响。这些因素可能完全基于不可改变的特征（如种族或性别），需要研究这些人口统计信息对预测准确性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学中的风险偏好和时间偏好理论，结合社会认同理论和群体内偏好理论，探讨人口统计特征如何影响对他人偏好的预测准确性。
AI.method: 采用两阶段实验设计：第一阶段，参与者通过修改版双倍多重价格列表（DMPL）引出各自的风险和时间偏好；第二阶段，被试基于仅有的性别或人口统计信息预测他人在DMPL中的决策，并针对特定群体调整预测。
AI.findings: （基于摘要，具体结果未提供，但研究设计旨在检验：1）仅基于人口统计信息的预测准确性；2）同群体预测是否存在信息优势；3）预测者如何根据群体信息调整预测）
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了风险和时间偏好预测的理论框架，纳入人口统计特征因素；2）为群体内偏好理论提供实证检验；3）深化对基于有限信息进行社会判断的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为战略决策者提供关于如何基于有限信息评估对手偏好的实践指导；2）揭示人口统计特征在预测中的潜在偏差；3）为减少基于刻板印象的预测提供实证基础。

title: The UK's middle-income dietary trap: high emissions, low nutrition
affiliations: Shanghai University, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, Vienna University of Economics and Business, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, Shanghai University and University of South Australia - School of Mathematics and Statistics, Centre for Food Policy, City, University of London

detail.title: The UK's middle-income dietary trap: high emissions, low nutrition
detail.abstract: Dietary transitions driven by income disparity increasingly impose a dual burden on health and the climate. This study integrates the Nutrient Rich Food Index (NRF9.3) and Global Warming Potential (GWP) to evaluate the nutrition-carbon trade-off in UK household food purchases in 2013. Our analysis reveals a “middle-income dietary trap”. Across Deciles 4-8, households increase their overall food purchases as income rises, but this expansion is dominated by carbon-intensive, nutrient-poor foods such as meats, dairy, sugars, and vegetable oils. As a consequence, calorie intake peaks while improvements in diet quality lag behind, and carbon emissions reach their highest levels among all income groups. This misalignment reflects a stage in which rising food quantity precedes nutritional gains, generating a dual burden of high-carbon, low-nutrition diets. In contrast, high-income groups (Deciles 9-10) achieve modest improvements in both nutrition and carbon efficiency, associated with higher consumption of nutrient-dense, low-GWP foods such as vegetables, fruits, and seafood. These findings highlight a non-linear income-emission relationship, consistent with the environmental Kuznets curve hypothesis. Our decomposition analysis identifies two mechanisms shaping dietary carbon efficiency: a static opposition between expenditure and energy density, and a dynamic trade-off between nutrient density and the carbon intensity of nutrients. Policy interventions should prioritize reducing beef consumption, promoting plant-based and nutrient-rich foods, and addressing structural drivers of unsustainable choices to help middle-income households escape this trap and mitigate the dual burden.

AI.tldr: 英国研究发现中等收入家庭存在"饮食陷阱"：收入增加时主要购买高碳低营养食品，导致热量摄入峰值但营养改善滞后，碳排放最高。高收入群体则能实现营养和碳效率的双重改善。
AI.research_question: 收入差异如何影响英国家庭食品购买中的营养-碳排放权衡关系？是否存在"中等收入饮食陷阱"现象？
AI.motivation: 收入差距驱动的饮食转型对健康和气候造成双重负担，需要理解不同收入群体在营养和碳排放之间的权衡关系，为政策干预提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营养丰富食品指数(NRF9.3)、全球变暖潜能值(GWP)、环境库兹涅茨曲线假设、营养-碳排放权衡理论
AI.method: 整合NRF9.3和GWP评估英国家庭食品购买数据(2013年)，进行分解分析，识别静态和动态机制
AI.findings: 发现"中等收入饮食陷阱"现象(第4-8十分位)：收入增加时主要购买高碳低营养食品，热量摄入峰值但营养改善滞后，碳排放最高。高收入群体(第9-10十分位)能实现营养和碳效率的双重改善。营养-碳排放效率受两个机制影响：支出与能量密度的静态对立，营养密度与营养素碳强度的动态权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"中等收入饮食陷阱"概念；2) 验证了环境库兹涅茨曲线在饮食领域的非线性关系；3) 识别了影响饮食碳效率的两个关键机制；4) 拓展了营养-碳排放权衡理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定提供实证依据：优先减少牛肉消费、推广植物性和营养丰富食品；2) 帮助中等收入家庭摆脱饮食陷阱；3) 缓解饮食对健康和气候的双重负担；4) 为可持续饮食转型提供具体路径
